B2L01-1-01.chinese: 你打電話給我的時候，我在睡覺，還沒起來。
B2L01-1-01.pinyin: Nǐ dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ de shíhòu, wǒ zài shuìjiào, háiméi qǐlái.
B2L01-1-01.english: When you called me, I was sleeping and hadn't gotten up yet.

B2L01-1-03.chinese: 我早上起來的時候，覺得頭很疼。
B2L01-1-03.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshàng qǐlái de shíhòu, juéde tóu hěn téng.
B2L01-1-03.english: When I got up in the morning, I felt a bad headache.

B2L01-1-04.chinese: 晚上我有事，要出去一下。
B2L01-1-04.pinyin: Wǎnshàng wǒ yǒu shì, yào chūqù yíxià.
B2L01-1-04.english: I have something to do tonight; I need to go out for a bit.

B2L01-1-05.chinese: 我的背很疼，吃了藥還是不舒服。
B2L01-1-05.pinyin: Wǒ de bèi hěn téng, chī le yào háishì bù shūfu.
B2L01-1-05.english: My back hurts a lot; even after taking medicine, I'm still not feeling well.

B2L01-1-06.chinese: 生病的時候，最好在家休息或是去看醫生。
B2L01-1-06.pinyin: Shēngbìng de shíhòu, zuìhǎo zài jiā xiūxí huòshì qù kàn yīshēng.
B2L01-1-06.english: When you're sick, you had better rest at home or go see a doctor.

B2L01-1-07.chinese: 生病的時候，最好在家休息或是去看醫生。
B2L01-1-07.pinyin: Shēngbìng de shíhòu, zuìhǎo zài jiā xiūxí huòshì qù kàn yīshēng.
B2L01-1-07.english: When you're sick, you had better rest at home or go see a doctor.

B2L01-1-08.chinese: 我的頭很疼，你可以幫我去藥房買藥嗎？
B2L01-1-08.pinyin: Wǒ de tóu hěn téng, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ qù yàofáng mǎi yào ma?
B2L01-1-08.english: My head hurts a lot; can you help me go to the pharmacy to buy medicine?

B2L01-1-09.chinese: 我的頭很疼，你可以幫我去藥局買藥嗎？
B2L01-1-09.pinyin: Wǒ de tóu hěn téng, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ qù yàojú mǎi yào ma?
B2L01-1-09.english: My head hurts a lot; can you help me go to the pharmacy to buy medicine?

B2L01-1-10.chinese: 我去夜市，不但想吃牛肉麵，也想喝珍珠奶茶。
B2L01-1-10.pinyin: Wǒ qù yèshì, búdàn xiǎng chī niúròu miàn, yě xiǎng hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
B2L01-1-10.english: When I go to the night market, I not only want to eat beef noodles but also want to drink bubble tea.

B2L01-1-11.chinese: 李先生的女朋友又溫柔又客氣。
B2L01-1-11.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng de nǚpéngyǒu yòu wēnróu yòu kèqì.
B2L01-1-11.english: Mr. Li's girlfriend is both gentle and polite.

B2L01-1-12.chinese: 李先生的女朋友又溫柔又客氣。
B2L01-1-12.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng de nǚpéngyǒu yòu wēnróu yòu kèqì.
B2L01-1-12.english: Mr. Li's girlfriend is both gentle and polite.

B2L01-1-13.chinese: 我跟朋友聊天，聊得很愉快。
B2L01-1-13.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyǒu liáotiān, liáo dehěn yúkuài.
B2L01-1-13.english: I chatted with friends and enjoyed it very much.

B2L01-1-14.chinese: 我覺得你一個人跟不認識的人見面，不太安全。
B2L01-1-14.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǐ yígerén gēn bú rènshì de rén jiànmiàn, bú tài ānquán.
B2L01-1-14.english: I think it's not very safe for you to meet someone you don't know by yourself.

B2L01-1-15.chinese: 這個禮拜六我們學校有舞會，你要參加嗎？
B2L01-1-15.pinyin: Zhège lǐbàiliù wǒmen xuéxiào yǒu wǔhuì, nǐ yào cānjiā ma?
B2L01-1-15.english: This Saturday our school has a dance party; do you want to attend?

B2L01-1-16.chinese: 今天是我第一天上班，當然不能遲到。
B2L01-1-16.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ dìyī tiān shàngbān, dāngrán bùnéng chídào.
B2L01-1-16.english: Today is my first day at work; of course I can't be late.

B2L01-1-17.chinese: 王小姐跟男朋友約會的時候，都穿著很漂亮的衣服。今天晚上哥哥跟女朋友有個約會。
B2L01-1-17.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě gēn nánpéngyǒu yuēhuì de shíhòu, dōu chuān zhe hěn piàoliàng de yīfu. Jīntiān wǎnshàng gēge gēn nǚpéngyǒu yǒu ge yuēhuì.
B2L01-1-17.english: When Miss Wang goes on a date with her boyfriend, she always wears very pretty clothes. Tonight my older brother has a date with his girlfriend.

B2L01-1-18.chinese: 天黑了，那個小孩子很害怕，不敢一個人去上廁所。
B2L01-1-18.pinyin: Tiān hēi le, nàge xiǎoháizi hěn hàipà, bù gǎn yígerén qù shàng cèsuǒ.
B2L01-1-18.english: It got dark, and that child was very afraid; he didn't dare go to the bathroom alone.

B2L01-1-19.chinese: 天黑了，那個小孩子很害怕，不敢一個人去上廁所。
B2L01-1-19.pinyin: Tiān hēi le, nàge xiǎoháizi hěn hàipà, bù gǎn yígerén qù shàng cèsuǒ.
B2L01-1-19.english: It got dark, and that child was very afraid; he didn't dare go to the bathroom alone.

B2L01-1-20.chinese: 我要打電話給他的時候，他剛好打來了。
B2L01-1-20.pinyin: Wǒ yào dǎ diànhuà gěi tā de shíhòu, tā gānghǎo dǎ lái le.
B2L01-1-20.english: When I was about to call him, it just so happened that he called.

B2L01-1-21.chinese: 這個動物園裡有很多動物，我最喜歡的是老虎跟猴子。
B2L01-1-21.pinyin: Zhège dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō dòngwù, wǒ zuì xǐhuān de shì lǎohǔ gēn hóuzi.
B2L01-1-21.english: There are many animals in this zoo; my favorites are the tigers and monkeys.

B2L01-1-22.chinese: 李先生喜歡開玩笑，是一個很有趣的人。
B2L01-1-22.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng xǐhuān kāiwánxiào, shì yíge hěn yǒuqù de rén.
B2L01-1-22.english: Mr. Li likes to make jokes; he is a very interesting person.

B2L01-1-23.chinese: 大家看完演唱會，就回家了。
B2L01-1-23.pinyin: Dàjiā kàn wán yǎnchànghuì, jiù huí jiā le.
B2L01-1-23.english: After everyone finished watching the concert, they went home.

B2L01-1-24.chinese: 他想摸摸看這杯水是熱的還是冷的。
B2L01-1-24.pinyin: Tā xiǎng mō mō kàn zhè bēi shuǐ shì rè de háishì lěng de.
B2L01-1-24.english: He wants to touch this glass of water to see whether it's hot or cold.

B2L01-1-25.chinese: 他今天怎麼了？好像不太高興。
B2L01-1-25.pinyin: Tā jīntiān zěnmele? Hǎoxiàng bú tài gāoxìng.
B2L01-1-25.english: What's wrong with him today? He seems not very happy.

B2L01-2-01.chinese: 她很害羞，不敢跟不認識的人說話。
B2L01-2-01.pinyin: Tā hěn hàixiū, bù gǎn gēn bú rènshì de rén shuōhuà.
B2L01-2-01.english: She is very shy and doesn't dare talk to people she doesn't know.

B2L01-2-04.chinese: 我跟她不太熟，所以不知道她喜歡喝什麼茶。
B2L01-2-04.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā bú tài shóu, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào tā xǐhuān hē shénme chá.
B2L01-2-04.english: I'm not very familiar with her, so I don't know what tea she likes to drink.

B2L01-2-05.chinese: 走路的時候看手機是很危險的。
B2L01-2-05.pinyin: Zǒulù de shíhòu kàn shǒujī shì hěn wéixiǎn de.
B2L01-2-05.english: Looking at your phone while walking is very dangerous.

B2L01-2-06.chinese: 弟弟今天一直在看書，都沒休息。
B2L01-2-06.pinyin: Dìdi jīntiān yìzhí zài kàn shū, dōu méi xiūxí.
B2L01-2-06.english: My younger brother has been reading all the time today and hasn't rested at all.

B2L01-2-07.chinese: 爸爸坐在沙發上，不久就想睡覺了。
B2L01-2-07.pinyin: Bàba zuò zài shāfā shàng, bùjiǔ jiù xiǎng shuìjiào le.
B2L01-2-07.english: Dad sat on the sofa, and soon after he wanted to sleep.

B2L01-2-12.chinese: 這個活動不好玩，大家都希望趕快結束。
B2L01-2-12.pinyin: Zhège huódòng bù hǎowán, dàjiā dōu xīwàng gǎnkuài jiéshù.
B2L01-2-12.english: This activity isn't fun; everyone hopes it will end soon.

B2L01-2-14.chinese: 那三個孩子手拉著手，一起去公園玩。
B2L01-2-14.pinyin: Nà sān ge háizi shǒu lā zhe shǒu, yìqǐ qù gōngyuán wán.
B2L01-2-14.english: Those three children, holding hands, went to the park to play together.

B2L01-2-15.chinese: 他玩遊戲贏了一萬塊錢，真幸運！
B2L01-2-15.pinyin: Tā wán yóuxì yíng le yíwàn kuài qián, zhēn xìngyùn!
B2L01-2-15.english: He won ten thousand dollars playing games—so lucky!

B2L01-2-16.chinese: 雖然中國字很難寫，可是我覺得很漂亮。
B2L01-2-16.pinyin: Suīrán Zhōngguó zì hěn nán xiě, kěshì wǒ juéde hěn piàoliàng.
B2L01-2-16.english: Although Chinese characters are hard to write, I think they are beautiful.

B2L01-2-17.chinese: 我不喜歡踢足球，因為腳很容易受傷。
B2L01-2-17.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuān tī zúqiú, yīnwèi jiǎo hěn róngyì shòushāng.
B2L01-2-17.english: I don't like playing soccer because feet get injured easily.

B2L02-1-01.chinese: 時間不早了，我得回家了。
B2L02-1-01.pinyin: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒ děi huí jiā le.
B2L02-1-01.english: It's getting late; I have to go home.

B2L02-1-02.pinyin: Zài nǐ jiā, shéi zuò jiāshì?
B2L02-1-02.english: In your family, who does the housework?

B2L02-1-03.chinese: 後天就要開學了，你的課本都買了嗎？
B2L02-1-03.pinyin: Hòutiān jiùyào kāixué le, nǐ de kèběn dōu mǎi le ma?
B2L02-1-03.english: School starts the day after tomorrow; have you bought all your textbooks?

B2L02-1-13.chinese: 從我家到學校要一個小時。
B2L02-1-13.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào xuéxiào yào yíge xiǎoshí.
B2L02-1-13.english: It takes one hour from my home to school.

B2L02-1-14.chinese: 這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
B2L02-1-14.pinyin: Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu háiméi cāgān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
B2L02-1-14.english: I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

B2L02-1-15.chinese: 昨天洗的衣服乾了沒有？這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
B2L02-1-15.pinyin: Zuótiān xǐ de yīfu gān le méiyǒu? Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu háiméi cāgān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
B2L02-1-15.english: Are the clothes washed yesterday dry yet? I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

B2L02-1-16.chinese: 來台灣學中文以前，我把一些舊書丟了。聽說你的車子丟了。是在哪裡丟的？
B2L02-1-16.pinyin: Lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén yǐqián, wǒ bǎ yìxiē jiù shū diū le. Tīngshuō nǐ de chēzi diū le. Shì zài nǎlǐ diū de?
B2L02-1-16.english: Before coming to Taiwan to study Chinese, I threw away some old books. I heard your car was lost. Where was it lost?

B2L02-1-17.chinese: 那位客人的錢包丟了，非常著急。
B2L02-1-17.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén de qiánbāo diū le, fēicháng zhāojí.
B2L02-1-17.english: That customer's wallet was lost, and he is very anxious.

B2L02-1-19.chinese: 教室很髒，老師叫學生下課以後打掃一下。
B2L02-1-19.pinyin: Jiàoshì hěn zāng, lǎoshī jiào xuéshēng xiàkè yǐhòu dǎsǎo yíxià.
B2L02-1-19.english: The classroom is very dirty, so the teacher told the students to clean it up after class.

B2L02-1-20.chinese: 你多久沒打掃房間了？真髒！
B2L02-1-20.pinyin: Nǐ duōjiǔ méi dǎsǎo fángjiān le? Zhēn zāng!
B2L02-1-20.english: How long has it been since you cleaned your room? It's really dirty!

B2L02-1-22.chinese: 火車應該快到了，我們去前面排隊吧。
B2L02-1-22.pinyin: Huǒchē yīnggāi kuài dào le, wǒmen qù qiánmiàn páiduì ba.
B2L02-1-22.english: The train should be arriving soon; let's go line up in front.

B2L02-1-24.chinese: 我爺爺在鄉下有一塊地，他有時間就去那裡種花。
B2L02-1-24.pinyin: Wǒ yéye zài xiāngxià yǒu yíkuài dì, tā yǒu shíjiān jiù qù nàlǐ zhǒng huā.
B2L02-1-24.english: My grandfather has a plot of land in the countryside; whenever he has time, he goes there to grow flowers.

B2L02-1-25.chinese: 暑假的時候，我跟弟弟一起做家事。我掃地，他洗碗筷。
B2L02-1-25.pinyin: Shǔjià de shíhòu, wǒ gēn dìdi yìqǐ zuò jiāshì. Wǒ sǎodì, tā xǐ wǎnkuài.
B2L02-1-25.english: During summer vacation, I do housework together with my younger brother. I sweep the floor, and he washes the dishes.

B2L02-1-26.chinese: 我現在還在上中文課，十二點才結束。
B2L02-1-26.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài hái zài shàng Zhōngwén kè, shí'èr diǎn cái jiéshù.
B2L02-1-26.english: I'm still in Chinese class right now; it doesn't end until twelve o'clock.

B2L02-1-28.chinese: 念了一個小時的書以後，你最好休息十分鐘。
B2L02-1-28.pinyin: Niàn le yíge xiǎoshí de shū yǐhòu, nǐ zuìhǎo xiūxí shífēn zhōng.
B2L02-1-28.english: After studying for an hour, you had better rest for ten minutes.

B2L02-1-29.chinese: 昨天老師教的日本歷史，你念了嗎？這個字我沒學過，怎麼唸？
B2L02-1-29.pinyin: Zuótiān lǎoshī jiāo de Rìběn lìshǐ, nǐ niàn le ma? Zhège zì wǒ méi xué guò, zěnme niàn?
B2L02-1-29.english: Have you studied the Japanese history that the teacher taught yesterday? I haven't learned this character; how do you pronounce it?

B2L02-1-31.chinese: 你要把這些小說都丟了？太可惜了！
B2L02-1-31.pinyin: Nǐ yào bǎ zhèxiē xiǎoshuō dōu diū le? Tài kěxí le!
B2L02-1-31.english: You're going to throw away all these novels? What a pity!

B2L02-1-32.chinese: 這種藥很有用，吃了以後頭就不疼了。
B2L02-1-32.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào hěn yǒuyòng, chī le yǐhòu tóu jiù bù téng le.
B2L02-1-32.english: This kind of medicine is very useful; after taking it, your head won't hurt anymore.

B2L02-2-02.chinese: 我一出門就看見朋友在外面等我。
B2L02-2-02.pinyin: Wǒ yì chūmén jiù kànjiàn péngyǒu zài wàimiàn děng wǒ.
B2L02-2-02.english: As soon as I went out the door, I saw my friend waiting for me outside.

B2L02-2-04.chinese: 我發現他的生肖跟我一樣，都是屬牛的。
B2L02-2-04.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn tā de shēngxiào gēn wǒ yíyàng, dōu shì shǔ niú de.
B2L02-2-04.english: I found out that his Chinese zodiac sign is the same as mine—we are both born in the Year of the Ox.

B2L02-2-05.chinese: 我打開袋子，看見裡面都是垃圾。
B2L02-2-05.pinyin: Wǒ dǎkāi dàizi, kànjiàn lǐmiàn dōu shì lèsè.
B2L02-2-05.english: I opened the bag and saw that it was all garbage inside.

B2L02-2-08.chinese: 上樓、下樓的時候都不要急，小心走。
B2L02-2-08.pinyin: Shàng lóu, xià lóu de shíhòu dōu búyào jí, xiǎoxīn zǒu.
B2L02-2-08.english: When going upstairs or downstairs, don't be in a hurry; walk carefully.

B2L02-2-09.chinese: 山本良介要從台北車站搭捷運回去。
B2L02-2-09.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè yào cóng Táiběi Chēzhàn dā jiéyùn huíqù.
B2L02-2-09.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke wants to take the MRT back from Taipei Main Station.

B2L02-2-10.chinese: 合歡山山上的空氣很好，風景也不錯。
B2L02-2-10.pinyin: Héhuān Shān shān shàng de kōngqì hěn hǎo, fēngjǐng yě búcuò.
B2L02-2-10.english: The air on Hehuan Mountain is very good, and the scenery is not bad either.

B2L02-2-11.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜，味道都很好。
B2L02-2-11.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài, wèidào dōu hěn hǎo.
B2L02-2-11.english: The dishes at this restaurant all taste very good.

B2L02-2-13.chinese: 這個地方到處都有垃圾，又髒又臭，誰要住在這裡呢？
B2L02-2-13.pinyin: Zhège dìfāng dàochù dōu yǒu lèsè, yòu zāng yòu chòu, shéi yào zhù zài zhèlǐ ne?
B2L02-2-13.english: This place has garbage everywhere; it's both dirty and smelly—who would want to live here?

B2L02-2-14.chinese: 夏天到了，天氣熱了，蟲子也多了。
B2L02-2-14.pinyin: Xiàtiān dào le, tiānqì rè le, chóngzi yě duō le.
B2L02-2-14.english: Summer has arrived, the weather has gotten hot, and there are more bugs too.

B2L02-2-15.chinese: 他把全部的碗筷都擦乾了，可以給客人用了。
B2L02-2-15.pinyin: Tā bǎ quánbù de wǎnkuài dōu cāgān le, kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng le.
B2L02-2-15.english: He wiped all the bowls and chopsticks dry; they can be used for the guests now.

B2L02-2-16.chinese: 我忘了倒垃圾，所以家裡很臭。客人來的時候，我們要倒茶請他們喝。
B2L02-2-16.pinyin: Wǒ wàngle dào lèsè, suǒyǐ jiālǐ hěn chòu. Kèrén lái de shíhòu, wǒmen yào dào chá qǐng tāmen hē.
B2L02-2-16.english: I forgot to take out the garbage, so the house smells bad. When guests come, we should pour tea and invite them to drink.

B2L02-2-17.chinese: 我得寫完作業，才可以跟你去看電影。
B2L02-2-17.pinyin: Wǒ děi xiě wán zuòyè, cái kěyǐ gēn nǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
B2L02-2-17.english: I have to finish my homework; only then can I go to the movies with you.

B2L02-2-18.chinese: 我的同學住在我家旁邊，他也是我的鄰居。
B2L02-2-18.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngxué zhù zài wǒ jiā pángbiān, tā yě shì wǒ de línjū.
B2L02-2-18.english: My classmate lives next to my house; he is also my neighbor.

B2L02-2-19.chinese: 住在這裡很安全，你不用擔心。
B2L02-2-19.pinyin: Zhù zài zhèlǐ hěn ānquán, nǐ búyòng dānxīn.
B2L02-2-19.english: Living here is very safe; you don't need to worry.

B2L02-2-21.chinese: 你不要亂吃東西，小心肚子疼！
B2L02-2-21.pinyin: Nǐ búyào luàn chī dōngxi, xiǎoxīn dùzi téng!
B2L02-2-21.english: Don't eat things randomly; be careful of a stomachache!

B2L03-1-01.chinese: 我想在學校附近租房子，去學校比較方便。
B2L03-1-01.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài xuéxiào fùjìn zū fángzi, qù xuéxiào bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
B2L03-1-01.english: I want to rent a house near the school; it's more convenient to get to school.

B2L03-1-05.chinese: 我可以自己回家，你不用陪我。
B2L03-1-05.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ zìjǐ huí jiā, nǐ búyòng péi wǒ.
B2L03-1-05.english: I can go home by myself; you don't need to accompany me.

B2L03-1-07.chinese: 這棟公寓有五層樓，四樓要出租。
B2L03-1-07.pinyin: Zhè dòng gōngyù yǒu wǔ céng lóu, sì lóu yào chūzū.
B2L03-1-07.english: This apartment building has five floors; the fourth floor is for rent.

B2L03-1-08.chinese: 他住在五樓，我們上去找他吧。
B2L03-1-08.pinyin: Tā zhù zài wǔ lóu, wǒmen shàngqù zhǎo tā ba.
B2L03-1-08.english: He lives on the fifth floor; let's go up to look for him.

B2L03-1-14.chinese: 牆上掛著的那張畫是我爸爸畫的。
B2L03-1-14.pinyin: Qiángshàng guà zhe de nà zhāng huà shì wǒ bàba huà de.
B2L03-1-14.english: That painting hanging on the wall was painted by my dad.

B2L03-1-19.chinese: 你的臥室看起來真漂亮！
B2L03-1-19.pinyin: Nǐ de wòshì kànqǐlái zhēn piàoliàng!

B2L03-1-21.chinese: 這附近有捷運站和公車站，交通很便利。
B2L03-1-21.pinyin: Zhè fùjìn yǒu jiéyùn zhàn hé gōngchē zhàn, jiāotōng hěn biànlì.
B2L03-1-21.english: There are MRT and bus stations near here; the transportation is very convenient.

B2L03-1-22.chinese: 我的手很疼，你可以替我洗碗嗎？
B2L03-1-22.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒu hěn téng, nǐ kěyǐ tì wǒ xǐwǎn ma?
B2L03-1-22.english: My hand really hurts; can you wash the dishes for me?

B2L03-1-23.chinese: 台灣的夏天很熱，所以很多人的家裡都裝了冷氣。這個袋子很大，可以裝很多東西。
B2L03-1-23.pinyin: Táiwān de xiàtiān hěn rè, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén de jiālǐ dōu zhuāng le lěngqì. Zhège dàizi hěn dà, kěyǐ zhuāng hěn duō dōngxi.
B2L03-1-23.english: Summers in Taiwan are very hot, so many people's homes have installed air conditioning. This bag is very big; it can pack a lot of things.

B2L03-1-24.chinese: 這次旅行的費用很高，因為車票很貴。
B2L03-1-24.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng de fèiyòng hěn gāo, yīnwèi chēpiào hěn guì.
B2L03-1-24.english: The cost of this trip is very high because the tickets are expensive.

B2L03-1-25.chinese: 你唱的這首英文歌，聽起來真好聽，可以教我嗎？
B2L03-1-25.pinyin: Nǐ chàng de zhè shǒu Yīngwén gē, tīngqǐlái zhēn hǎotīng, kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
B2L03-1-25.english: This English song you're singing sounds really nice; can you teach me?

B2L03-1-30.chinese: 這個房子的房租不包括水費、電費。
B2L03-1-30.pinyin: Zhège fángzi de fángzū bù bāokuò shuǐfèi, diànfèi.
B2L03-1-30.english: The rent for this house does not include the water fee and electricity fee.

B2L03-1-32.chinese: 下課以後，我要跟同學討論去日月潭旅行的事情。
B2L03-1-32.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ yào gēn tóngxué tǎolùn qù Rìyuè Tán lǚxíng de shìqíng.
B2L03-1-32.english: After class, I want to discuss the trip to Sun Moon Lake with my classmates.

B2L03-1-33.chinese: 我在公車站等了一會兒，公車就來了。
B2L03-1-33.pinyin: Wǒ zài gōngchē zhàn děng le yìhuǐr, gōngchē jiù lái le.
B2L03-1-33.english: I waited at the bus stop for a while, and then the bus came.

B2L03-1-34.chinese: 請把洗衣機放在這邊，冰箱放在那邊。
B2L03-1-34.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xǐyījī fàng zài zhèbiān, bīngxiāng fàng zài nàbiān.
B2L03-1-34.english: Please put the washing machine here and the refrigerator there.

B2L03-1-36.chinese: 付了房租以後，你這個月的獎學金還剩多少？弟弟把菜都吃完了，什麼都沒剩。
B2L03-1-36.pinyin: Fù le fángzū yǐhòu, nǐ zhège yuè de jiǎngxuéjīn hái shèng duōshǎo? Dìdi bǎ cài dōu chī wán le, shénme dōu méi shèng.
B2L03-1-36.english: After paying the rent, how much of this month's scholarship do you still have left? My little brother ate all the food; nothing is left.

B2L03-1-37.chinese: 老師很滿意大家這次期中考的成績。這次期中考，大家都考得很好，老師覺得很滿意。
B2L03-1-37.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn mǎnyì dàjiā zhè cì qízhōngkǎo de chéngjī. Zhè cì qízhōngkǎo, dàjiā dōu kǎo dehěn hǎo, lǎoshī juéde hěn mǎnyì.
B2L03-1-37.english: The teacher is very satisfied with everyone's midterm exam results. On this midterm exam, everyone did very well, and the teacher feels very satisfied.

B2L03-1-39.chinese: 我打算明年到美國去留學。
B2L03-1-39.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn míngnián dào Měiguó qù liúxué.
B2L03-1-39.english: I plan to go to the United States to study abroad next year.

B2L03-1-40.chinese: 他去了好幾家便利商店，可是都沒有他要買的東西。
B2L03-1-40.pinyin: Tā qù le hǎojǐ jiā biànlì shāngdiàn, kěshì dōu méiyǒu tā yào mǎi de dōngxi.
B2L03-1-40.english: He went to several convenience stores, but none of them had what he wanted to buy.

B2L03-1-41.chinese: 那家工廠的工作很辛苦，可是錢很多，所以很多人願意做。
B2L03-1-41.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng de gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì qián hěn duō, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén yuànyì zuò.
B2L03-1-41.english: The work at that factory is very hard, but the pay is good, so many people are willing to do it.

B2L03-1-42.chinese: 我下禮拜要跟房東簽約，你可以陪我去嗎？
B2L03-1-42.pinyin: Wǒ xià lǐbài yào gēn fángdōng qiānyuē, nǐ kěyǐ péi wǒ qù ma?
B2L03-1-42.english: I'm going to sign the lease with the landlord next week; can you come with me?

B2L03-1-44.chinese: 便利商店不遠，從我家過去只要五分鐘。
B2L03-1-44.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn bù yuǎn, cóng wǒ jiā guòqù zhǐyào wǔ fēnzhōng.
B2L03-1-44.english: The convenience store is not far; going over from my home takes only five minutes.

B2L03-1-47.chinese: 房東給了我鑰匙，明天就可以搬進去了。
B2L03-1-47.pinyin: Fángdōng gěi le wǒ yàoshi, míngtiān jiù kěyǐ bān jìnqù le.
B2L03-1-47.english: The landlord gave me the key, so I can move in tomorrow.

B2L03-2-02.chinese: 他家離公司不遠，所以總是走路去上班。
B2L03-2-02.pinyin: Tā jiā lí gōngsī bù yuǎn, suǒyǐ zǒngshì zǒulù qù shàngbān.
B2L03-2-02.english: His home is not far from the company, so he always walks to work.

B2L03-2-05.chinese: 弟弟半夜在房間聽音樂，聲音很吵。
B2L03-2-05.pinyin: Dìdi bànyè zài fángjiān tīng yīnyuè, shēngyīn hěn chǎo.
B2L03-2-05.english: My little brother listens to music in his room in the middle of the night, and the sound is very noisy.

B2L03-2-08.chinese: 除了台北101，你還去過哪些地方？
B2L03-2-08.pinyin: Chúle Táiběi 101, nǐ hái qù guo nǎxiē dìfāng?
B2L03-2-08.english: In addition to Taipei 101, what other places have you been to?

B2L03-2-09.chinese: 媽媽不在，晚飯我得自己弄。弟弟把房間弄得又髒又亂，誰也不想進去。
B2L03-2-09.pinyin: Māma bú zài, wǎnfàn wǒ děi zìjǐ nòng. Dìdi bǎ fángjiān nòng de yòu zāng yòu luàn, shéi yě bù xiǎng jìnqù.
B2L03-2-09.english: Mom isn't home, so I have to make dinner myself. My little brother made the room both dirty and messy; no one wants to go in.

B2L03-2-10.chinese: 這次的旅行很順利，沒有什麼問題。
B2L03-2-10.pinyin: Zhè cì de lǚxíng hěn shùnlì, méiyǒu shénme wèntí.
B2L03-2-10.english: This trip was very smooth; there were no problems.

B2L03-2-12.chinese: 我父母這個週末都不在家，家裡只剩下我一個人。我已經把衣服洗完了，剩下的家事請你做。
B2L03-2-12.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ zhège zhōumò dōu bú zài jiā, jiālǐ zhǐ shèngxià wǒ yígerén. Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ yīfu xǐ wán le, shèngxià de jiāshì qǐng nǐ zuò.
B2L03-2-12.english: My parents are both not at home this weekend; only I am left at home. I have already finished washing the clothes; please do the remaining housework.

B2L03-2-14.chinese: 到國外生活以前，得先找租房子的資料。我覺得台灣的生活費不太高，日本的比較高。
B2L03-2-14.pinyin: Dào guówài shēnghuó yǐqián, de xiān zhǎo zū fángzi de zīliào. Wǒ juéde Táiwān de shēnghuó fèi bú tài gāo, Rìběn de bǐjiào gāo.
B2L03-2-14.english: Before going abroad to live, you must first look for information about renting a place. I think the cost of living in Taiwan is not too high; Japan's is higher.

B2L03-2-15.chinese: 我的房東都是每個月五號來收房租的。
B2L03-2-15.pinyin: Wǒ de fángdōng dōu shì měi ge yuè wǔ hào lái shōu fángzū de.
B2L03-2-15.english: My landlord always comes to collect the rent on the fifth of every month.

B2L03-2-16.chinese: 山本良介來台灣以後，搬了兩次家。
B2L03-2-16.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè lái Táiwān yǐhòu, bān le liǎng cì jiā.
B2L03-2-16.english: After Yamamoto Ryosuke came to Taiwan, he moved house twice.

B2L04-1-02.chinese: 我們在逛夜市的時候，忽然下雨了。
B2L04-1-02.pinyin: Wǒmen zài guàng yèshì de shíhòu, hūrán xiàyǔ le.
B2L04-1-02.english: While we were strolling through the night market, it suddenly started to rain.

B2L04-1-05.chinese: 我剛到台灣兩天，還不知道怎麼去郵局。
B2L04-1-05.pinyin: Wǒ gāng dào Táiwān liǎng tiān, hái bù zhīdào zěnme qù yóujú.
B2L04-1-05.english: I just arrived in Taiwan two days ago, and I still don't know how to get to the post office.

B2L04-1-07.chinese: A:夜市在哪裡？ B:夜市就在前面！
B2L04-1-07.pinyin: A: Yèshì zài nǎlǐ? B: Yèshì jiù zài qiánmiàn!
B2L04-1-07.english: A: Where is the night market? B: The night market is just right ahead!

B2L04-1-08.chinese: 夜市裡有各種小吃和飲料。
B2L04-1-08.pinyin: Yèshì lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng xiǎochī hé yǐnliào.
B2L04-1-08.english: In the night market, there are various kinds of snacks and drinks.

B2L04-1-10.chinese: 在夜市買東西的時候，有些人會跟老闆殺價。
B2L04-1-10.pinyin: Zài yèshì mǎi dōngxi de shíhòu, yǒuxiē rén huì gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
B2L04-1-10.english: When shopping at the night market, some people will bargain with the vendor.

B2L04-1-15.chinese: 炸雞排是我最喜歡的小吃。
B2L04-1-15.pinyin: Zhà jīpái shì wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiǎochī.
B2L04-1-15.english: Fried chicken cutlet is my favorite snack.

B2L04-1-16.pinyin: Māma zuò de cài, wèidào hěn xiāng.
B2L04-1-16.english: The food Mom makes smells very good.

B2L04-1-17.chinese: 他習慣睡覺以前聽一點兒音樂。
B2L04-1-17.pinyin: Tā xíguàn shuìjiào yǐqián tīng yìdiǎnr yīnyuè.
B2L04-1-17.english: He is used to listening to a little music before sleeping.

B2L04-1-19.chinese: 這兩件衣服都很漂亮，我不知道選哪一件比較好。
B2L04-1-19.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu dōu hěn piàoliàng, wǒ bù zhīdào xuǎn nǎ yí jiàn bǐjiào hǎo.
B2L04-1-19.english: Both of these two pieces of clothing are very pretty; I don't know which one is better to choose.

B2L04-1-20.chinese: 喝無糖的飲料比較健康。
B2L04-1-20.pinyin: Hē wú táng de yǐnliào bǐjiào jiànkāng.

B2L04-1-22.chinese: 我的房租每個月一萬塊，加上水費、電費，差不多一萬三。
B2L04-1-22.pinyin: Wǒ de fángzū měi ge yuè yíwàn kuài, jiāshàng shuǐfèi, diànfèi, chàbùduō yíwànsān.
B2L04-1-22.english: My rent is 10,000 dollars a month; plus water and electricity fees, it's about 13,000.

B2L04-1-23.chinese: 這本書要一千五百塊錢，我跟他的錢加起來還不夠。
B2L04-1-23.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yào yìqiānwǔbǎi kuài qián, wǒ gēn tā de qián jiā qǐlái hái bú gòu.
B2L04-1-23.english: This book costs 1,500 dollars; the money I have and his added together is still not enough.

B2L04-1-24.chinese: 我的飲料不要加糖和冰塊，謝謝。
B2L04-1-24.pinyin: Wǒ de yǐnliào búyào jiā táng hé bīngkuài, xièxie.
B2L04-1-24.english: I don't want sugar and ice cubes added to my drink, thank you.

B2L04-1-25.chinese: 朋友推薦我去參觀這裡有名的博物館。
B2L04-1-25.pinyin: Péngyǒu tuījiàn wǒ qù cānguān zhèlǐ yǒumíng de bówùguǎn.
B2L04-1-25.english: A friend recommended that I visit the famous museum here.

B2L04-1-26.chinese: 這個菜有一點兒辣，我不愛吃。
B2L04-1-26.pinyin: Zhège cài yǒuyìdiǎnr là, wǒ bú ài chī.
B2L04-1-26.english: This dish is a little spicy; I don't like to eat it.

B2L04-1-30.pinyin: Nǐ wén, nà shì shénme wèidào?

B2L04-1-31.chinese: 我討厭下雨，因為出去玩很不方便。
B2L04-1-31.pinyin: Wǒ tǎoyàn xiàyǔ, yīnwèi chūqù wán hěn bù fāngbiàn.
B2L04-1-31.english: I dislike rainy days because going out to have fun is very inconvenient.

B2L04-1-32.chinese: 這個菜看起來很辣，其實不太辣。
B2L04-1-32.pinyin: Zhège cài kànqǐlái hěn là, qíshí bú tài là.
B2L04-1-32.english: This dish looks very spicy, but in fact it's not very spicy.

B2L04-1-33.chinese: 我以前沒做過蛋糕，所以想試試。
B2L04-1-33.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián méi zuò guo dàngāo, suǒyǐ xiǎng shì shì.
B2L04-1-33.english: I have never made a cake before, so I want to try it.

B2L04-2-02.chinese: 他比一般孩子聰明，所以學得又快又好。
B2L04-2-02.pinyin: Tā bǐ yìbān háizi cōngmíng, suǒyǐ xué de yòu kuài yòu hǎo.
B2L04-2-02.english: He is smarter than ordinary children, so he learns both quickly and well.

B2L04-2-03.chinese: 我每天早上大概六點起床。
B2L04-2-03.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshàng dàgài liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
B2L04-2-03.english: I get up at about six o'clock every morning.

B2L04-2-04.chinese: 他每天只會吃喝玩樂，什麼都不做。
B2L04-2-04.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zhǐ huì chīhēwánlè, shénme dōu bú zuò.
B2L04-2-04.english: Every day he only eats, drinks, plays, and has fun; he doesn't do anything.

B2L04-2-05.chinese: 上下班的時候，捷運站有很多人，總是很擠。
B2L04-2-05.pinyin: Shàng xiàbān de shíhòu, jiéyùn zhàn yǒu hěn duō rén, zǒngshì hěn jǐ.
B2L04-2-05.english: During rush hour, there are many people at the MRT station; it's always very crowded.

B2L04-2-06.chinese: 台灣的夏天熱得不得了！
B2L04-2-06.pinyin: Táiwān de xiàtiān rè de bùdéliǎo!

B2L04-2-07.chinese: 暑假出國旅遊的人很多。這次的旅遊真有意思，我以後還想多去幾個地方玩。
B2L04-2-07.pinyin: Shǔjià chūguó lǚyóu de rén hěn duō. Zhè cì de lǚyóu zhēn yǒuyìsi, wǒ yǐhòu hái xiǎng duō qù jǐ ge dìfāng wán.
B2L04-2-07.english: Many people travel abroad during summer vacation. This trip is really interesting; in the future I want to go to more places to have fun.

B2L04-2-08.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì yuè lái yuè rè le!
B2L04-2-08.english: The weather has been getting hotter and hotter recently!

B2L04-2-09.chinese: 我常常跟朋友一起去逛街。
B2L04-2-09.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ qù guàngjiē.
B2L04-2-09.english: I often go shopping with friends.

B2L04-2-10.chinese: 他想多了解一點兒台灣文化，所以決定來台灣留學。
B2L04-2-10.pinyin: Tā xiǎng duō liǎojiě yìdiǎnr Táiwān wénhuà, suǒyǐ juédìng lái Táiwān liúxué.
B2L04-2-10.english: He wants to understand a little more about Taiwanese culture, so he decided to come to Taiwan to study abroad.

B2L04-2-12.chinese: 這種點心的做法很簡單，價錢也不貴。
B2L04-2-12.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng diǎnxīn de zuòfǎ hěn jiǎndān, jiàqián yě bú guì.
B2L04-2-12.english: The method for making this kind of snack is very simple, and the price is not expensive either.

B2L04-2-13.chinese: 那個照相機貴得不得了，我買不起。
B2L04-2-13.pinyin: Nàge zhàoxiàngjī guì de bùdéliǎo, wǒ mǎi bù qǐ.
B2L04-2-13.english: That camera is extremely expensive; I can't afford to buy it.

B2L04-2-14.chinese: 這個週末，我們要去湖邊烤肉。
B2L04-2-14.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò, wǒmen yào qù húbiān kǎo ròu.
B2L04-2-14.english: This weekend, we are going to the lakeside to barbecue.

B2L04-2-19.chinese: 夏天的時候，芒果冰、西瓜汁的生意好得不得了！
B2L04-2-19.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhòu, mángguǒ bīng, xīguā zhī de shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo!
B2L04-2-19.english: In summer, the business of mango shaved ice and watermelon juice is extremely good!

B2L04-2-21.chinese: 你只買了一份雞排，吃得飽嗎？
B2L04-2-21.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐ mǎi le yí fèn jīpái, chī de bǎo ma?
B2L04-2-21.english: You only bought one chicken cutlet; are you full from eating it?

B2L04-2-22.chinese: 這個電視節目很無聊，我們去看電影吧！
B2L04-2-22.pinyin: Zhège diànshì jiémù hěn wúliáo, wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba!
B2L04-2-22.english: This TV program is very boring; let's go see a movie!

B2L04-2-23.chinese: 媽媽有時候會跟市場的老闆講價，希望價錢能便宜一點兒。
B2L04-2-23.pinyin: Māma yǒushíhòu huì gēn shìchǎng de lǎobǎn jiǎngjià, xīwàng jiàqián néng piányí yìdiǎnr.
B2L04-2-23.english: Mom sometimes bargains with the market vendors, hoping the price can be a little cheaper.

B2L04-2-25.chinese: 他會說很多種語言，比如說：英文、法文、德文。
B2L04-2-25.pinyin: Tā huì shuō hěn duō zhǒng yǔyán, bǐrú shuō: Yīngwén, Fǎwén, Déwén.
B2L04-2-25.english: He can speak many kinds of languages, for example English, French and German.

B2L04-2-26.chinese: 龍山寺是台北很有名的寺廟，廟裡常常有很多外國遊客。
B2L04-2-26.pinyin: Lóngshān Sì shì Táiběi hěn yǒumíng de sìmiào, miào lǐ chángcháng yǒu hěn duō wàiguó yóukè.
B2L04-2-26.english: Longshan Temple is a very famous temple in Taipei; there are often many foreign tourists in the temple.

B2L04-2-27.chinese: 這本小說很有意思，值得推薦。雖然我排隊排了一個小時才買到跨年演唱會的票，可是很值得。
B2L04-2-27.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō hěn yǒuyìsi, zhídé tuījiàn. Suīrán wǒ páiduì pái le yíge xiǎoshí cái mǎi dào kuànián yǎnchànghuì de piào, kěshì hěn zhídé.
B2L04-2-27.english: This novel is very interesting and worth recommending. Although I waited in line for an hour before I got tickets to the New Year's Eve concert, it was very worth it.

B2L05-1-03.chinese: 我不知道我的書被誰拿走了。
B2L05-1-03.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào wǒ de shū bèi shéi názǒu le.
B2L05-1-03.english: I don't know who took my book away.

B2L05-1-05.chinese: 這個社區很安全，不用擔心小偷來偷東西。
B2L05-1-05.pinyin: Zhège shèqū hěn ānquán, búyòng dānxīn xiǎotōu lái tōu dōngxi.
B2L05-1-05.english: This community is very safe; you don't need to worry about thieves coming to steal things.

B2L05-1-06.chinese: 他是一個很負責的老師，每天都把學生寫的功課看完。
B2L05-1-06.pinyin: Tā shì yíge hěn fùzé de lǎoshī, měi tiān dōu bǎ xuéshēng xiě de gōngkè kàn wán.
B2L05-1-06.english: He is a very responsible teacher; every day he finishes reading the homework the students write.

B2L05-1-07.chinese: 王先生負責這個社區的安全，你有什麼問題可以問他。
B2L05-1-07.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng fùzé zhège shèqū de ānquán, nǐ yǒu shénme wèntí kěyǐ wèn tā.
B2L05-1-07.english: Mr. Wang is in charge of the safety of this community; if you have any questions, you can ask him.

B2L05-1-10.chinese: 這個星期六，我們要在社區的草地上辦活動。
B2L05-1-10.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù, wǒmen yào zài shèqū de cǎodì shàng bàn huódòng.
B2L05-1-10.english: This Saturday, we are going to hold an activity on the community lawn.

B2L05-1-13.chinese: 昨天我們去了一家韓國餐廳吃烤肉大餐。
B2L05-1-13.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen qù le yì jiā Hánguó cāntīng chī kǎoròu dà cān.
B2L05-1-13.english: Yesterday we went to a Korean restaurant to eat a big barbecue meal.

B2L05-1-14.chinese: 週末的時候，我喜歡跟朋友去野餐或是露營。
B2L05-1-14.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhòu, wǒ xǐhuān gēn péngyǒu qù yěcān huòshì lùyíng.
B2L05-1-14.english: On weekends, I like to go picnicking or camping with friends.

B2L05-1-18.chinese: 第一次約會的時候，林先生感覺（到）自己很緊張。要是沒有安全人員，我感覺住在這個社區很不安全。
B2L05-1-18.pinyin: Dìyīcì yuēhuì de shíhòu, Lín xiānshēng gǎnjué (dào) zìjǐ hěn jǐnzhāng. Yàoshì méiyǒu ānquán rényuán, wǒ gǎnjué zhù zài zhège shèqū hěn bù ānquán.
B2L05-1-18.english: On his first date, Mr. Lin felt (that) he was very nervous. If there were no security staff, I would feel it is very unsafe living in this community.

B2L05-1-19.chinese: 林明生躺在草地上看星星，他感覺真輕鬆。
B2L05-1-19.pinyin: Lín Míngshēng tǎng zài cǎodì shàng kàn xīngxīng, tā gǎnjué zhēn qīngsōng.
B2L05-1-19.english: Lin Mingsheng lies on the grass looking at the stars; he feels truly relaxed.

B2L05-1-20.chinese: 爸爸看電視，看著看著就睡著了。
B2L05-1-20.pinyin: Bàba kàn diànshì, kàn zhe kàn zhe jiù shuìzháo le.
B2L05-1-20.english: Dad was watching TV, and as he watched, he fell asleep.

B2L05-1-22.chinese: 我在公園散步的時候，聞到了花香。
B2L05-1-22.pinyin: Wǒ zài gōngyuán sànbù de shíhòu, wén dàoliǎo huāxiāng.
B2L05-1-22.english: When I was walking in the park, I smelled the fragrance of flowers.

B2L05-1-25.chinese: 我住的社區有一座游泳池，只要有空我就會去游泳。
B2L05-1-25.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de shèqū yǒu yí zuò yóuyǒngchí, zhǐyào yǒukòng wǒ jiù huì qù yóuyǒng.
B2L05-1-25.english: The community I live in has a swimming pool; as long as I have free time, I go swimming.

B2L05-1-27.chinese: 只要我有空，就去球場打球。
B2L05-1-27.pinyin: Zhǐyào wǒ yǒukòng, jiù qù qiúchǎng dǎ qiú.
B2L05-1-27.english: As long as I have free time, I go to the ball court to play ball.

B2L05-1-28.chinese: 今天我請客，大家要吃什麼、喝什麼，全部我付錢。
B2L05-1-28.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè, dàjiā yào chī shénme, hē shénme, quánbù wǒ fù qián.
B2L05-1-28.english: Today I'm treating, whatever everyone wants to eat or drink, I'll pay for it all.

B2L05-2-01.chinese: 父母都很愛我，所以我感覺幸福極了。
B2L05-2-01.pinyin: Fùmǔ dōu hěn ài wǒ, suǒyǐ wǒ gǎnjué xìngfú jíle.
B2L05-2-01.english: My parents both love me very much, so I feel extremely happy.

B2L05-2-02.chinese: 台北市在台灣的北部，有很多大樓。
B2L05-2-02.pinyin: Táiběi Shì zài Táiwān de běibù, yǒu hěn duō dàlóu.
B2L05-2-02.english: Taipei City is in northern Taiwan and has many tall buildings.

B2L05-2-04.chinese: 我是在台灣長大的，當然去過夜市。
B2L05-2-04.pinyin: Wǒ shì zài Táiwān zhǎngdà de, dāngrán qù guo yè shì.
B2L05-2-04.english: I grew up in Taiwan, so of course I've been to night markets.

B2L05-2-06.chinese: 大家都出去了，還好我帶了鑰匙。
B2L05-2-06.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu chūqù le, háihǎo wǒ dài le yàoshi.
B2L05-2-06.english: Everyone has gone out; luckily I brought my keys.

B2L05-2-08.chinese: 我到公車站的時候，剛好有一班公車來了，要不然上班就遲到了。
B2L05-2-08.pinyin: Wǒ dào gōngchē zhàn de shíhòu, gānghǎo yǒu yì bān gōngchē lái le, yàobùrán shàngbān jiù chídào le.
B2L05-2-08.english: When I got to the bus stop, a bus happened to arrive; otherwise I would have been late for work.

B2L05-2-09.chinese: 搬家是一件很麻煩的事情。
B2L05-2-09.pinyin: Bānjiā shì yí jiàn hěn máfán de shìqíng.
B2L05-2-09.english: Moving house is a very troublesome thing.

B2L05-2-10.chinese: 你經過便利商店的時候，可以幫我買一瓶水嗎？
B2L05-2-10.pinyin: Nǐ jīngguò biànlì shāngdiàn de shíhòu, kěyǐ bāng wǒ mǎi yì píng shuǐ ma?
B2L05-2-10.english: When you pass by the convenience store, can you buy a bottle of water for me?

B2L05-2-11.chinese: 他是這個社區的安全人員，負責大家的安全。
B2L05-2-11.pinyin: Tā shì zhège shèqū de ānquán rényuán, fùzé dàjiā de ānquán.
B2L05-2-11.english: He is the security staff of this community, responsible for everyone's safety.

B2L05-2-13.chinese: 這家超市的水果不但很新鮮，也很便宜。
B2L05-2-13.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì de shuǐguǒ búdàn hěn xīnxiān, yě hěn piányí.
B2L05-2-13.english: The fruit at this supermarket is not only very fresh but also very cheap.

B2L05-2-14.chinese: 他的眼睛像爸爸，嘴巴像媽媽。
B2L05-2-14.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjīng xiàng bàba, zuǐba xiàng māma.
B2L05-2-14.english: His eyes are like his dad's, and his mouth is like his mom's.

B2L05-2-17.chinese: 這座停車場很大，可以停五百輛汽車。
B2L05-2-17.pinyin: Zhè zuò tíngchēchǎng hěn dà, kěyǐ tíng wǔbǎi liàng qìchē.
B2L05-2-17.english: This parking lot is very big; it can hold five hundred cars.

B2L05-2-19.chinese: 昨天晚上的月亮又大又圓，你看到了嗎？
B2L05-2-19.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng de yuèliàng yòu dà yòu yuán, nǐ kàndào le ma?
B2L05-2-19.english: Last night's moon was both big and round—did you see it?

B2L05-2-22.chinese: 這個房子又大又舒服，房租只要三千塊，真是太便宜了！
B2L05-2-22.pinyin: Zhège fángzi yòu dà yòu shūfu, fángzū zhǐyào sānqiān kuài, zhēnshì tài piányí le!
B2L05-2-22.english: This house is both big and comfortable, and the rent is only 3,000 dollars—it's really too cheap!

B2L06-1-01.chinese: 我跟妹妹的興趣不同，她喜歡出去運動，我喜歡在家聽音樂。
B2L06-1-01.pinyin: Wǒ gēn mèimei de xìngqù bùtóng, tā xǐhuān chūqù yùndòng, wǒ xǐhuān zài jiā tīng yīnyuè.
B2L06-1-01.english: My interests are different from my younger sister's: she likes to go out and exercise, and I like to stay home and listen to music.

B2L06-1-02.chinese: 我跟室友的個性、興趣都差不多，所以我們是好朋友。
B2L06-1-02.pinyin: Wǒ gēn shìyǒu de gèxìng, xìngqù dōu chàbùduō, suǒyǐ wǒmen shì hǎo péngyǒu.
B2L06-1-02.english: My roommate and I are similar in personality and interests, so we are good friends.

B2L06-1-03.chinese: 雖然工作很重要，不過身體健康更重要。
B2L06-1-03.pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn zhòngyào, búguò shēntǐ jiànkāng gèng zhòngyào.
B2L06-1-03.english: Although work is important, health is even more important.

B2L06-1-04.chinese: 王先生來台灣的目的是學中文。
B2L06-1-04.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng lái Táiwān de mùdì shì xué Zhōngwén.
B2L06-1-04.english: Mr. Wang's purpose in coming to Taiwan is to study Chinese.

B2L06-1-05.chinese: 我點的這首歌很簡單，我們一起合唱吧！
B2L06-1-05.pinyin: Wǒ diǎn de zhè shǒu gē hěn jiǎndān, wǒmen yìqǐ héchàng ba!
B2L06-1-05.english: This song I requested is very simple; let's sing it together!

B2L06-1-06.chinese: 這個字你寫錯了，請再寫一次。
B2L06-1-06.pinyin: Zhège zì nǐ xiě cuò le, qǐng zài xiě yí cì.
B2L06-1-06.english: You wrote this character wrong; please write it again.

B2L06-1-08.chinese: 他們在KTV慶祝生日，又唱又跳，開心極了。
B2L06-1-08.pinyin: Tāmen zài KTV qìngzhù shēngrì, yòu chàng yòu tiào, kāixīn jíle.
B2L06-1-08.english: They are celebrating a birthday at KTV, singing and dancing, and are extremely happy.

B2L06-1-10.chinese: 隔壁的人在跳舞，我房間的地板也動了。你只要身體動一動，就不覺得冷了。
B2L06-1-10.pinyin: Gébì de rén zài tiàowǔ, wǒ fángjiān de dìbǎn yě dòng le. Nǐ zhǐyào shēntǐ dòng yí dòng, jiù bù juéde lěng le.
B2L06-1-10.english: The people next door are dancing, and the floor in my room is moving too. | As long as you move your body a little, you won't feel cold.

B2L06-1-11.chinese: 昨天朋友教我的那首英文歌，我已經學會了。
B2L06-1-11.pinyin: Zuótiān péngyǒu jiāo wǒ de nà shǒu Yīngwén gē, wǒ yǐjīng xuéhuì le.
B2L06-1-11.english: I have already learned that English song my friend taught me yesterday.

B2L06-1-13.chinese: 你最拿手的歌曲是哪一首？
B2L06-1-13.pinyin: Nǐ zuì náshǒu de gēqǔ shì nǎ yì shǒu?
B2L06-1-13.english: Which song are you best at?

B2L06-1-15.chinese: 請你想像一下，二十年以後，你的生活會怎麼樣？
B2L06-1-15.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiǎngxiàng yíxià, èrshí nián yǐhòu, nǐ de shēnghuó huì zěnmeyàng?
B2L06-1-15.english: Please imagine: twenty years from now, what will your life be like?

B2L06-1-18.chinese: 外面的風很大，聲音聽起來很可怕。
B2L06-1-18.pinyin: Wàimiàn de fēng hěn dà, shēngyīn tīngqǐlái hěn kěpà.
B2L06-1-18.english: The wind outside is very strong; the sound sounds very scary.

B2L06-1-19.chinese: 林小姐弄錯了約會的時間，所以遲到了半個小時。我覺得「害怕」跟「可怕」的意思差不多，所以常弄錯。
B2L06-1-19.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě nòngcuò le yuēhuì de shíjiān, suǒyǐ chídào le bàn ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ juéde “hàipà” gēn “kěpà” de yìsi chàbùduō, suǒyǐ cháng nòngcuò.
B2L06-1-19.english: Miss Lin made a mistake about the appointment time, so she was half an hour late. I think “afraid” and “scary” have similar meanings, so I often misunderstand.

B2L06-1-20.chinese: 這次考試的分數沒有我想的那麼差。
B2L06-1-20.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de fēnshù méiyǒu wǒ xiǎng de nàme chà.
B2L06-1-20.english: The score on this exam is not as bad as I thought.

B2L06-1-21.chinese: 這次考試很難，可是大家的分數都不低，好奇怪！
B2L06-1-21.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì hěn nán, kěshì dàjiā de fēnshù dōu bù dī, hǎo qíguài!
B2L06-1-21.english: This exam was very hard, but everyone's scores are not low—how strange!

B2L06-1-22.chinese: 你知道學中文有什麼好方法嗎？
B2L06-1-22.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào xué Zhōngwén yǒu shénme hǎo fāngfǎ ma?
B2L06-1-22.english: Do you know what good methods there are for learning Chinese?

B2L06-1-23.chinese: 這是我第一次搭飛機，所以覺得很興奮。
B2L06-1-23.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì dā fēijī, suǒyǐ juéde hěn xīngfèn.
B2L06-1-23.english: This is my first time taking an airplane, so I feel very excited.

B2L06-1-24.chinese: 我們去 KTV 開心地慶祝朋友的生日。
B2L06-1-24.pinyin: Wǒmen qù KTV kāixīn de qìngzhù péngyǒu de shēngrì.
B2L06-1-24.english: We went to KTV to happily celebrate a friend's birthday.

B2L06-1-25.chinese: 這麼多好朋友來幫我過生日，真棒！
B2L06-1-25.pinyin: Zhème duō hǎo péngyǒu lái bāng wǒ guò shēngrì, zhēn bàng!
B2L06-1-25.english: So many good friends came to help me celebrate my birthday—really great!

B2L06-1-26.chinese: 我要好好（兒）地練習唱歌，去 KTV 的時候才能唱給大家聽。
B2L06-1-26.pinyin: Wǒ yào hǎohǎo (r) de liànxí chànggē, qù KTV de shíhòu cáinéng chàng gěi dàjiā tīng.
B2L06-1-26.english: I want to practice singing properly, so that when I go to KTV I can sing for everyone to hear.

B2L06-1-27.chinese: 要買什麼生日禮物送給女朋友，你想到了嗎？
B2L06-1-27.pinyin: Yào mǎi shénme shēngrì lǐwù sòng gěi nǚpéngyǒu, nǐ xiǎngdào le ma?
B2L06-1-27.english: Have you thought of what birthday gift to buy for your girlfriend?

B2L06-1-30.chinese: 我送了一束玫瑰花給女朋友，一共有二十朵。
B2L06-1-30.pinyin: Wǒ sòng le yí shù méigui huā gěi nǚpéngyǒu, yígòng yǒu èrshí duǒ.
B2L06-1-30.english: I gave my girlfriend a bunch of roses, twenty in all.

B2L06-1-31.pinyin: Bié zài jiàoshì lǐ chī dōngxi!

B2L06-1-32.chinese: 我去便利商店買了三罐啤酒，五瓶果汁。
B2L06-1-32.pinyin: Wǒ qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi le sān guàn píjiǔ, wǔ píng guǒzhī.
B2L06-1-32.english: I went to the convenience store and bought three cans of beer and five bottles of juice.

B2L06-1-33.chinese: 我去便利商店買了三罐啤酒，五瓶果汁。
B2L06-1-33.pinyin: Wǒ qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi le sān guàn píjiǔ, wǔ píng guǒzhī.
B2L06-1-33.english: I went to the convenience store and bought three cans of beer and five bottles of juice.

B2L06-1-34.chinese: 你明天有考試，要早一點兒起床喔！
B2L06-1-34.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, yào zǎo yìdiǎnr qǐchuáng o!
B2L06-1-34.english: You have an exam tomorrow, so get up a little earlier, okay!

B2L06-1-35.chinese: 你知道他要結婚的消息了嗎？
B2L06-1-35.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tā yào jiéhūn de xiāoxí le ma?
B2L06-1-35.english: Did you know the news that he is getting married?

B2L06-2-01.chinese: 在台灣，不少人去KTV慶祝生日或是辦活動。
B2L06-2-01.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo rén qù KTV qìngzhù shēngrì huòshì bàn huódòng.
B2L06-2-01.english: In Taiwan, many people go to KTV to celebrate birthdays or hold events.

B2L06-2-02.chinese: 週末我都在家，隨時歡迎你來玩。
B2L06-2-02.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dōu zài jiā, suíshí huānyíng nǐ lái wán.
B2L06-2-02.english: On weekends I am always at home; you are welcome to come over anytime.

B2L06-2-04.chinese: 李先生每天晚上六點前一定要吃晚飯，八點後就什麼東西都不吃了。
B2L06-2-04.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng měitiān wǎnshàng liù diǎn qián yídìng yào chī wǎnfàn, bā diǎn hòu jiù shénme dōngxi dōu bù chī le.
B2L06-2-04.english: Mr. Li must eat dinner before six o'clock every evening; after eight o'clock he doesn't eat anything at all.

B2L06-2-05.chinese: 那個孩子才兩歲，還不會寫字。
B2L06-2-05.pinyin: Nàge háizi cái liǎng suì, hái bú huì xiě zì.
B2L06-2-05.english: That child is only two years old and still doesn't know how to write.

B2L06-2-08.chinese: 那家餐廳的菜又便宜又好吃，所以假日常常客滿。
B2L06-2-08.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de cài yòu piányí yòu hǎochī, suǒyǐ jiàrì chángcháng kèmǎn.
B2L06-2-08.english: That restaurant's food is both cheap and delicious, so it is often fully occupied on holidays.

B2L06-2-09.chinese: 很多大學生利用暑假去國外旅行或是學語言。
B2L06-2-09.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng lìyòng shǔjià qù guówài lǚxíng huòshì xué yǔyán.
B2L06-2-09.english: Many college students use summer vacation to travel abroad or learn languages.

B2L06-2-10.chinese: 王先生年輕時去過英國留學，所以英文說得不錯。
B2L06-2-10.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng niánqīng shí qù guo Yīngguó liúxué, suǒyǐ Yīngwén shuō de búcuò.
B2L06-2-10.english: When Mr. Wang was young, he studied abroad in England, so he speaks English quite well.

B2L06-2-11.chinese: 在台北市租房子太貴了，住在郊區可以省一點兒錢。
B2L06-2-11.pinyin: Zài Táiběi Shì zū fángzi tài guì le, zhù zài jiāoqū kěyǐ shěng yìdiǎnr qián.
B2L06-2-11.english: Renting a house in Taipei City is too expensive; living in the suburbs can save a little money.

B2L06-2-12.chinese: 旅行的目的除了看風景，還可以了解那個地方的文化特色。
B2L06-2-12.pinyin: Lǚxíng de mùdì chúle kàn fēngjǐng, hái kěyǐ liǎojiě nàge dìfāng de wénhuà tèsè.
B2L06-2-12.english: The purpose of travel, besides seeing the scenery, is also to understand the cultural features of that place.

B2L06-2-13.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，除了有各式各樣的小吃，還有不少好玩的遊戲。
B2L06-2-13.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, chúle yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, háiyǒu bùshǎo hǎowán de yóuxì.
B2L06-2-13.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive; besides having various snacks, there are also quite a few fun games.

B2L06-2-14.chinese: 我沒發燒，不必去看醫生，在家休息一下就好了。
B2L06-2-14.pinyin: Wǒ méi fāshāo, búbì qù kàn yīshēng, zài jiā xiūxí yíxià jiù hǎo le.
B2L06-2-14.english: I don't have a fever, so I don't have to go see a doctor; just resting at home for a bit will be fine.

B2L06-2-16.chinese: 結婚的時候，先生送了她一棟房子，讓她開心極了。
B2L06-2-16.pinyin: Jiéhūn de shíhòu, xiānshēng sòng le tā yí dòng fángzi, ràng tā kāixīn jíle.
B2L06-2-16.english: When they got married, her husband gave her a house, which made her extremely happy.

B2L06-2-17.chinese: 他常常遲到，讓老闆很生氣。弟弟的房間又髒又亂，已經三個月沒打掃了，所以媽媽生他的氣。
B2L06-2-17.pinyin: Tā chángcháng chídào, ràng lǎobǎn hěn shēngqì. Dìdi de fángjiān yòu zāng yòu luàn, yǐjīng sān ge yuè méi dǎsǎo le, suǒyǐ māma shēng tā de qì.
B2L06-2-17.english: He is often late, which makes his boss very angry. / Younger brother's room is both dirty and messy; it has been three months since it was cleaned, so mom is angry at him.

B2L06-2-18.chinese: 王小姐的男朋友不愛她了，真的傷了她的心。
B2L06-2-18.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě de nánpéngyǒu bú ài tā le, zhēnde shāng le tā de xīn.
B2L06-2-18.english: Miss Wang's boyfriend doesn't love her anymore; it really broke her heart.

B2L06-2-19.chinese: 聽到那首歌，讓李小姐哭得很傷心。
B2L06-2-19.pinyin: Tīngdào nà shǒu gē, ràng Lǐ xiǎojiě kū dehěn shāngxīn.
B2L06-2-19.english: Hearing that song made Miss Li cry very sadly.

B2L06-2-20.chinese: 去KTV辦活動，是一個不錯的選擇。
B2L06-2-20.pinyin: Qù KTV bàn huódòng, shì yíge búcuò de xuǎnzé.
B2L06-2-20.english: Holding an event at a KTV is a pretty good choice.

B2L07-1-04.chinese: 我買了幾包花蓮當地的名產，要送給台北的朋友。
B2L07-1-04.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le jǐ bāo Huālián dāngdì de míngchǎn, yào sòng gěi Táiběi de péngyǒu.
B2L07-1-04.english: I bought several packs of Hualien's local specialties to give to my friends in Taipei.

B2L07-1-06.chinese: 我常上網訂車票、訂旅館，又快又方便。
B2L07-1-06.pinyin: Wǒ cháng shàngwǎng dìng chēpiào, dìng lǚguǎn, yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn.
B2L07-1-06.english: I often go online to book train tickets and book hotels; it's fast and convenient.

B2L07-1-08.chinese: 這家咖啡館有免費的無線網路，我可以邊喝咖啡邊上網。
B2L07-1-08.pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēiguǎn yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù, wǒ kěyǐ biān hē kāfēi biān shàngwǎng.
B2L07-1-08.english: This café has free Wi-Fi; I can drink coffee while surfing the internet.

B2L07-1-09.chinese: 這家民宿的旁邊就是美麗的海邊，風景美極了。
B2L07-1-09.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù de pángbiān jiùshì měilì de hǎibiān, fēngjǐng měi jíle.
B2L07-1-09.english: Right next to this guesthouse is a beautiful beach; the scenery is extremely beautiful.

B2L07-1-10.chinese: 這家民宿的旁邊就是美麗的海邊，風景美極了。
B2L07-1-10.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù de pángbiān jiùshì měilì de hǎibiān, fēngjǐng měi jíle.
B2L07-1-10.english: Right next to this guesthouse is a beautiful beach; the scenery is extremely beautiful.

B2L07-1-11.chinese: 美國的一毛錢差不多是台灣的三塊錢。
B2L07-1-11.pinyin: Měiguó de yì máo qián chàbùduō shì Táiwān de sān kuài qián.
B2L07-1-11.english: One dime in the US is about three dollars in Taiwan.

B2L07-1-12.chinese: 今天是妹妹的生日，讓我們一起去 KTV 慶祝吧。弟弟還沒十八歲，爸爸不讓他喝酒。
B2L07-1-12.pinyin: Jīntiān shì mèimei de shēngrì, ràng wǒmen yìqǐ qù KTV qìngzhù ba. Dìdi háiméi shíbā suì, bàba bú ràng tā hē jiǔ.
B2L07-1-12.english: Today is younger sister's birthday; let's go to KTV to celebrate together. / Younger brother is not yet eighteen, so dad doesn't allow him to drink alcohol.

B2L07-1-13.chinese: 我們正在烤肉的時候，忽然下雨了。
B2L07-1-13.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài kǎo ròu de shíhòu, hūrán xiàyǔ le.
B2L07-1-13.english: While we were having a barbecue, it suddenly started to rain.

B2L07-1-17.chinese: 這條公路很危險，一下大雨，山上的石頭就會掉下來。
B2L07-1-17.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gōnglù hěn wéixiǎn, yíxià dà yǔ, shān shàng de shítou jiù huì diàoxiàlái.
B2L07-1-17.english: This road is very dangerous; whenever it rains heavily, rocks from the mountain will fall down.

B2L07-1-19.chinese: 週末到花蓮的火車票一下子就賣光了。
B2L07-1-19.pinyin: Zhōumò dào Huālián de huǒchēpiào yíxiàzi jiù mài guāng le.
B2L07-1-19.english: Weekend train tickets to Hualien sold out in an instant.

B2L07-1-20.chinese: 這條鐵路從北部一直到南部，一共三百公里。
B2L07-1-20.pinyin: Zhè tiáo tiělù cóng běibù yìzhí dào nánbù, yígòng sānbǎi gōnglǐ.
B2L07-1-20.english: This railway goes from the north all the way to the south, a total of 300 kilometers.

B2L07-1-23.chinese: 那家印尼餐廳常常客滿，你最好先打電話訂位。
B2L07-1-23.pinyin: Nà jiā Yìnní cāntīng chángcháng kèmǎn, nǐ zuìhǎo xiān dǎ diànhuà dìngwèi.
B2L07-1-23.english: That Indonesian restaurant is often full; you'd better call ahead to make a reservation.

B2L07-1-24.chinese: 這個月底我就可以把這本書學完了。
B2L07-1-24.pinyin: Zhège yuè dǐ wǒ jiù kěyǐ bǎ zhè běn shū xué wánle.
B2L07-1-24.english: By the end of this month I will be able to finish studying this book.

B2L07-1-25.chinese: 這班車早上七點從台北出發，只停三個站就到花蓮了。
B2L07-1-25.pinyin: Zhè bān chē zǎoshàng qī diǎn cóng Táiběi chūfā, zhǐ tíng sān ge zhàn jiù dào Huālián le.
B2L07-1-25.english: This train leaves Taipei at seven in the morning and gets to Hualien after stopping at only three stations.

B2L07-1-27.chinese: 爬山是很好的運動。那個孩子還不會走路，只會在地上爬。
B2L07-1-27.pinyin: Pá shān shì hěn hǎo de yùndòng. Nàge háizi hái bú huì zǒulù, zhǐ huì zài dìshàng pá.
B2L07-1-27.english: Mountain climbing is a very good exercise. / That child can't walk yet; he can only crawl on the ground.

B2L07-1-28.chinese: 我要搭火車去東部，座位是3車16號。
B2L07-1-28.pinyin: Wǒ yào dā huǒchē qù dōngbù, zuòwèi shì 3 chē 16 hào.
B2L07-1-28.english: I'm going to take the train to the east; my seat is car 3, number 16.

B2L07-1-29.chinese: 搭火車的時候，我喜歡坐在窗戶旁邊的位子，邊聽音樂邊看風景。
B2L07-1-29.pinyin: Dā huǒchē de shíhòu, wǒ xǐhuān zuò zài chuānghù pángbiān de wèizi, biān tīng yīnyuè biān kàn fēngjǐng.
B2L07-1-29.english: When taking the train, I like to sit in a seat by the window, listening to music while looking at the scenery.

B2L07-1-31.chinese: 我把搭車的日期、時間都記下來了。
B2L07-1-31.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ dā chē de rìqí, shíjiān dōu jìxiàlái le.
B2L07-1-31.english: I have written down the date and time of the train ride.

B2L07-2-04.chinese: 我計畫暑假跟朋友到南部去走走。
B2L07-2-04.pinyin: Wǒ jìhuà shǔjià gēn péngyǒu dào nánbù qù zǒuzǒu.
B2L07-2-04.english: I plan to go to the south with friends to walk around during summer vacation.

B2L07-2-06.chinese: 春天來了，天氣暖和了，森林裡的草也綠了。
B2L07-2-06.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì nuǎnhuo le, sēnlín lǐ de cǎo yě lǜ le.
B2L07-2-06.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warm, and the grass in the forest has also turned green.

B2L07-2-09.chinese: 我的行李很重，除了大衣、外套，還裝了一些書。
B2L07-2-09.pinyin: Wǒ de xínglǐ hěn zhòng, chúle dàyī, wàitào, hái zhuāng le yìxiē shū.
B2L07-2-09.english: My luggage is very heavy; besides a coat and a jacket, I also packed some books.

B2L07-2-13.chinese: 參加團體旅遊比較不自由，可是不必自己訂旅館、訂車票。
B2L07-2-13.pinyin: Cānjiā tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐjiào bú zìyóu, kěshì búbì zìjǐ dìng lǚguǎn, dìng chēpiào.
B2L07-2-13.english: Joining a group tour is less free, but you don't have to book hotels and tickets yourself.

B2L07-2-14.chinese: 因為我趕時間，所以得搭計程車去車站。
B2L07-2-14.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ gǎn shíjiān, suǒyǐ děi dā jìchéngchē qù chēzhàn.
B2L07-2-14.english: Because I am in a hurry, I have to take a taxi to the station.

B2L07-2-15.chinese: 我很喜歡那個房子，看房子當天就跟房東簽約了。
B2L07-2-15.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān nàge fángzi, kàn fángzi dāngtiān jiù gēn fángdōng qiānyuē le.
B2L07-2-15.english: I really like that house; on the day I viewed it, I signed the contract with the landlord.

B2L07-2-16.chinese: 花蓮的風景很美，我想多留兩天，慢慢地看。
B2L07-2-16.pinyin: Huālián de fēngjǐng hěn měi, wǒ xiǎng duō liú liǎng tiān, mànmàn de kàn.
B2L07-2-16.english: Hualien's scenery is beautiful; I want to stay two more days and look around slowly.

B2L07-2-17.chinese: 我覺得畢業後要出國留學或是留在國內工作，都是不錯的選擇。
B2L07-2-17.pinyin: Wǒ juéde bìyè hòu yào chūguó liúxué huòshì liú zài guónèi gōngzuò, dōu shì búcuò de xuǎnzé.
B2L07-2-17.english: I think that after graduating, going abroad to study or staying to work in this country are both good choices.

B2L07-2-18.chinese: 沒想到利用春假出國旅行的人真不少！
B2L07-2-18.pinyin: Méixiǎngdào lìyòng chūnjià chūguó lǚxíng de rén zhēn bùshǎo!
B2L07-2-18.english: I didn't expect that there are really quite a few people who take advantage of spring break to travel abroad!

B2L07-2-19.chinese: 他昨天去逛夜市的時候，信用卡被偷了。
B2L07-2-19.pinyin: Tā zuótiān qù guàng yèshì de shíhòu, xìnyòngkǎ bèi tōu le.
B2L07-2-19.english: When he went to the night market yesterday, his credit card was stolen.

B2L07-2-20.chinese: 我寫信給父母，跟他們說我在台灣很安全，請他們放心。
B2L07-2-20.pinyin: Wǒ xiě xìn gěi fùmǔ, gēn tāmen shuō wǒ zài Táiwān hěn ānquán, qǐng tāmen fàngxīn.
B2L07-2-20.english: I wrote a letter to my parents, telling them that I am very safe in Taiwan and asking them to rest assured.

B2L07-2-21.chinese: 李小姐趁出國時，在機場買了一瓶有名的香水。
B2L07-2-21.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě chèn chūguó shí, zài jīchǎng mǎi le yì píng yǒumíng de xiāngshuǐ.
B2L07-2-21.english: Ms. Li, while taking advantage of going abroad, bought a bottle of famous perfume at the airport.

B2L07-2-22.chinese: 他在 KTV 唱歌的樣子，好像歌星一樣。那件外套的樣子是今年最流行的。
B2L07-2-22.pinyin: Tā zài KTV chànggē de yàngzi, hǎoxiàng gēxīng yíyàng. Nà jiàn wàitào de yàngzi shì jīnnián zuì liúxíng de.
B2L07-2-22.english: The way he sings at KTV is like a pop star. The style of that jacket is the most popular this year.

B2L07-2-23.chinese: 到東部的火車票很難訂，我訂了好幾次才成功。這次社區的中秋節活動辦得很成功，大家都玩得很開心。
B2L07-2-23.pinyin: Dào dōngbù de huǒchēpiào hěn nán dìng, wǒ dìng le hǎojǐ cì cái chénggōng. Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiū Jié huódòng bàn dehěn chénggōng, dàjiā dōu wán dehěn kāixīn.
B2L07-2-23.english: Tickets for trains to the east are hard to book; I tried several times before succeeding. This time the community's Mid-Autumn Festival event was very successful, and everyone had a great time.

B2L08-1-01.chinese: 請不要把貼紙貼在教室的桌子上。
B2L08-1-01.pinyin: Qǐng búyào bǎ tiēzhǐ tiē zài jiàoshì de zhuōzi shàng.
B2L08-1-01.english: Please don't stick stickers on the classroom desks.

B2L08-1-07.chinese: 今天的考試，姐姐差兩分就一百了，真可惜！
B2L08-1-07.pinyin: Jīntiān de kǎoshì, jiějie chà liǎng fēn jiù yìbǎi le, zhēn kěxí!
B2L08-1-07.english: On today's exam, my older sister was short of two points to reach 100—what a pity!

B2L08-1-11.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，只要滿兩千塊，就送一盤水果。
B2L08-1-11.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, zhǐyào mǎn liǎngqiān kuài, jiù sòng yì pán shuǐguǒ.
B2L08-1-11.english: When you eat at this restaurant, as soon as the bill reaches two thousand dollars, you get a plate of fruit free.

B2L08-1-12.chinese: 莫以凡覺得推薦的「薦」很難寫，連他的台灣朋友也常寫錯。
B2L08-1-12.pinyin: Mò Yǐfán juéde tuījiàn de “jiàn” hěn nán xiě, lián tā de Táiwān péngyǒu yě cháng xiě cuò.
B2L08-1-12.english: Mo Yifan thinks the character 'jian' in 'recommend' is hard to write; even his Taiwanese friends often write it wrong.

B2L08-1-13.chinese: 他的成績很好，有機會得到出國留學的獎學金。
B2L08-1-13.pinyin: Tā de chéngjī hěn hǎo, yǒu jīhuì dédào chūguó liúxué de jiǎngxuéjīn.
B2L08-1-13.english: His grades are very good; he has a chance to get a scholarship to study abroad.

B2L08-1-14.chinese: 像珍珠奶茶那樣的飲料，在日本也很受歡迎。
B2L08-1-14.pinyin: Xiàng zhēnzhū nǎichá nàyàng de yǐnliào, zài Rìběn yě hěn shòu huānyíng.
B2L08-1-14.english: Drinks like bubble tea are also very popular in Japan.

B2L08-1-16.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，吸引了不少外國遊客。
B2L08-1-16.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, xīyǐn le bùshǎo wàiguó yóukè.
B2L08-1-16.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive and have attracted many foreign tourists.

B2L08-1-24.chinese: 我妹妹非常喜愛像Hello Kitty那樣的卡通人物。
B2L08-1-24.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei fēicháng xǐ'ài xiàng Hello Kitty nàyàng de kǎtōng rénwù.
B2L08-1-24.english: My younger sister really likes cartoon characters like Hello Kitty.

B2L08-1-25.chinese: 我忘了帶課本，上課的時候只好跟同學一起看。
B2L08-1-25.pinyin: Wǒ wàngle dài kèběn, shàngkè de shíhòu zhǐhǎo gēn tóngxué yìqǐ kàn.
B2L08-1-25.english: I forgot to bring my textbook, so during class I had no choice but to share with a classmate.

B2L08-1-26.chinese: 我想要得到便利商店的貼紙，所以花了很多錢買東西。
B2L08-1-26.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngyào dédào biànlì shāngdiàn de tiēzhǐ, suǒyǐ huā le hěn duō qián mǎi dōngxi.
B2L08-1-26.english: I wanted to get the convenience store stickers, so I spent a lot of money buying things.

B2L08-1-27.chinese: 這個演唱會，從開始到最後都很好看。
B2L08-1-27.pinyin: Zhège yǎnchànghuì, cóng kāishǐ dào zuìhòu dōu hěn hǎokàn.
B2L08-1-27.english: This concert was great from start to finish.

B2L08-1-28.chinese: 為了身體健康，你應該常常運動。
B2L08-1-28.pinyin: Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, nǐ yīnggāi chángcháng yùndòng.
B2L08-1-28.english: For your health, you should exercise often.

B2L08-1-30.chinese: 以前沒什麼人喜歡露營，可是最近露營變成了一種流行的活動。
B2L08-1-30.pinyin: Yǐqián méishénme rén xǐhuān lùyíng, kěshì zuìjìn lùyíng biànchéng le yì zhǒng liúxíng de huódòng.
B2L08-1-30.english: Before, not many people liked camping, but recently camping has become a popular activity.

B2L08-1-31.chinese: 昨天華語中心辦的中秋節活動，所有學生都來參加了。
B2L08-1-31.pinyin: Zuótiān Huáyǔ Zhōngxīn bàn de Zhōngqiū Jié huódòng, suǒyǒu xuéshēng dōu lái cānjiā le.
B2L08-1-31.english: At the Mid-Autumn Festival activity held by the Mandarin Center yesterday, all the students came to participate.

B2L08-1-32.chinese: 把考試的日期記在手機裡，這樣做就不會忘了。
B2L08-1-32.pinyin: Bǎ kǎoshì de rìqí jì zài shǒujī lǐ, zhèyàng zuò jiù bú huì wàngle.
B2L08-1-32.english: Record the exam date in your phone; doing it this way, you won't forget.

B2L08-1-33.chinese: 不少人喜歡買像史努比那樣可愛的娃娃。
B2L08-1-33.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén xǐhuān mǎi xiàng Shǐnǔbǐ nàyàng kě'ài de wáwa.
B2L08-1-33.english: Many people like to buy cute dolls like Snoopy.

B2L08-1-34.chinese: 這一類的中文小說都放在圖書館的二樓。
B2L08-1-34.pinyin: Zhè yí lèi de Zhōngwén xiǎoshuō dōu fàng zài túshūguǎn de èr lóu.
B2L08-1-34.english: Chinese novels of this category are all placed on the second floor of the library.

B2L08-1-35.chinese: 吃太多炸的東西，對身體會有不好的影響。
B2L08-1-35.pinyin: Chī tài duō zhà de dōngxi, duì shēntǐ huì yǒu bùhǎo de yǐngxiǎng.
B2L08-1-35.english: Eating too much fried food will have a bad influence on your health.

B2L08-1-36.chinese: 今年去台北 101 跨年的人比去年增加了十萬人。
B2L08-1-36.pinyin: Jīnnián qù Táiběi 101 kuànián de rén bǐ qùnián zēngjiā le shíwàn rén.
B2L08-1-36.english: This year 100,000 more people went to Taipei 101 for New Year's Eve than last year.

B2L08-1-37.chinese: 我買了幾張當地的明信片，這些是這次旅行很好的紀念。
B2L08-1-37.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le jǐ zhāng dāngdì de míngxìnpiàn, zhèxiē shì zhè cì lǚxíng hěn hǎo de jìniàn.
B2L08-1-37.english: I bought several local postcards; these are a very good souvenir of this trip.

B2L08-1-39.chinese: 新年是一個新的開始，所以每年一開始就要做好計畫。
B2L08-1-39.pinyin: Xīnnián shì yíge xīn de kāishǐ, suǒyǐ měi nián yìkāishǐ jiùyào zuò hǎo jìhuà.
B2L08-1-39.english: The New Year is a new beginning, so at the beginning of every year, you should make a good plan.

B2L08-2-01.chinese: 陳可欣覺得方靜文變了，可是靜文覺得自己沒變。
B2L08-2-01.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn juéde Fāng Jìngwén biàn le, kěshì Jìngwén juéde zìjǐ méi biàn.
B2L08-2-01.english: Chen Kexin feels that Fang Jingwen has changed, but Jingwen feels that she herself hasn't changed.

B2L08-2-03.chinese: 我以為今天有考試，其實是明天才考。
B2L08-2-03.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi jīntiān yǒu kǎoshì, qíshí shì míngtiān cái kǎo.
B2L08-2-03.english: I thought there was an exam today, but actually it's not until tomorrow that we have the exam.

B2L08-2-04.chinese: 那個學生已經一個星期沒來上課了，他發生了什麼事？
B2L08-2-04.pinyin: Nàge xuéshēng yǐjīng yíge xīngqí méi lái shàngkè le, tā fāshēng le shénme shì?
B2L08-2-04.english: That student hasn't come to class for a week already; what happened to him?

B2L08-2-06.chinese: 陳可欣因為感冒的關係，在家休息了幾天。
B2L08-2-06.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn yīnwèi gǎnmào de guānxì, zài jiā xiūxí le jǐ tiān.
B2L08-2-06.english: Because of a cold, Chen Kexin rested at home for a few days.

B2L08-2-14.chinese: 我的汽車每半年就需要保養一次。
B2L08-2-14.pinyin: Wǒ de qìchē měi bàn nián jiù xūyào bǎoyǎng yí cì.
B2L08-2-14.english: My car needs maintenance once every half year.

B2L08-2-16.chinese: 我想利用後年的暑假去英國遊學。
B2L08-2-16.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng lìyòng hòunián de shǔjià qù Yīngguó yóuxué.
B2L08-2-16.english: I want to use the summer vacation of the year after next to go on a study tour to the UK.

B2L08-2-18.chinese: 在台灣，去KTV唱歌是很平常的活動。
B2L08-2-18.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, qù KTV chànggē shì hěn píngcháng de huódòng.
B2L08-2-18.english: In Taiwan, going to KTV to sing is a very common activity.

B2L08-2-19.chinese: 你打算用什麼方式來慶祝父親六十歲的生日？
B2L08-2-19.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn yòng shénme fāngshì lái qìngzhù fùqīn liùshí suì de shēngrì?
B2L08-2-19.english: In what way do you plan to celebrate your father's sixtieth birthday?

B2L08-2-20.chinese: 這裡的交通有很大的改變，比以前方便多了。
B2L08-2-20.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng yǒu hěn dà de gǎibiàn, bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn duō le.
B2L08-2-20.english: The transportation here has undergone a big change; it's much more convenient than before.

B2L09-1-03.chinese: 現在開始上課，請大家把書翻到第九課。
B2L09-1-03.pinyin: Xiànzài kāishǐ shàngkè, qǐng dàjiā bǎ shū fān dào dì jiǔ kè.
B2L09-1-03.english: Class starts now; everyone, please turn your books to Lesson 9.

B2L09-1-04.chinese: 這本中文書，我念到第四十三頁了。
B2L09-1-04.pinyin: Zhè běn Zhōng wén shū, wǒ niàn dào dì sìshísān yè le.
B2L09-1-04.english: I've read up to page 43 of this Chinese book.

B2L09-1-06.chinese: 這學期我選了三門課，聽說都不輕鬆！
B2L09-1-06.pinyin: Zhè xuéqí wǒ xuǎn le sān mén kè, tīngshuō dōu bù qīngsōng!
B2L09-1-06.english: This semester I've chosen three courses; I've heard they're all not easy!

B2L09-1-07.chinese: 下星期一有課堂小考和口試，我得好好準備。
B2L09-1-07.pinyin: Xià xīngqíyī yǒu kètáng xiǎo kǎo hé kǒushì, wǒ děi hǎohǎo zhǔnbèi.
B2L09-1-07.english: Next Monday there's a class quiz and an oral test; I must prepare well.

B2L09-1-09.chinese: 我上次口試的時候太緊張，所以沒聽懂老師問的問題。
B2L09-1-09.pinyin: Wǒ shàng cì kǒushì de shíhòu tài jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ méi tīngdǒng lǎoshī wèn de wèntí.
B2L09-1-09.english: Last time during the oral test, I was too nervous, so I didn't understand the questions the teacher asked.

B2L09-1-10.chinese: 這個週末我得寫一篇五百字的作文。
B2L09-1-10.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ děi xiě yì piān wǔbǎi zì de zuòwén.
B2L09-1-10.english: This weekend I have to write a 500-character essay.

B2L09-1-11.chinese: 我不喜歡作文，因為我常常不知道要寫什麼。
B2L09-1-11.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuān zuòwén, yīnwèi wǒ chángcháng bù zhīdào yào xiě shénme.
B2L09-1-11.english: I don't like compositions, because I often don't know what to write.

B2L09-1-12.chinese: 這門課很難，我得用功一點兒，要不然老師可能會當了我。
B2L09-1-12.pinyin: Zhè mén kè hěn nán, wǒ děi yònggōng yìdiǎnr, yàobùrán lǎoshī kěnéng huì dāng le wǒ.
B2L09-1-12.english: This course is very hard; I need to study a bit harder, otherwise the teacher might flunk me.

B2L09-1-13.chinese: 這門課很難，我得用功一點兒，要不然老師可能會當了我。
B2L09-1-13.pinyin: Zhè mén kè hěn nán, wǒ de yònggōng yìdiǎnr, yàobùrán lǎoshī kěnéng huì dāng le wǒ.
B2L09-1-13.english: This course is hard. I have to study harder, or the teacher might fail me.

B2L09-1-14.chinese: 聽說王教授的課很有意思，下學期我要修他的課。
B2L09-1-14.pinyin: Tīngshuō Wáng jiàoshòu de kè hěn yǒuyìsi, xià xuéqí wǒ yào xiū tā de kè.
B2L09-1-14.english: I heard Professor Wang's class is very interesting; next semester I want to take his course.

B2L09-1-15.chinese: 聽說王教授的課很有意思，下學期我要修他的課。
B2L09-1-15.pinyin: Tīngshuō Wáng jiàoshòu de kè hěn yǒuyìsi, xià xuéqí wǒ yào xiū tā de kè.
B2L09-1-15.english: I heard Professor Wang's class is very interesting; next semester I want to take his course.

B2L09-1-16.chinese: 如果你希望有豐富的知識，就應該用功讀書。
B2L09-1-16.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xīwàng yǒu fēngfù de zhīshì, jiù yīnggāi yònggōng dúshū.
B2L09-1-16.english: If you hope to have abundant knowledge, you should study hard.

B2L09-1-17.chinese: 因為今天是爸爸的生日，所以晚餐非常豐富。
B2L09-1-17.pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān shì bàba de shēngrì, suǒyǐ wǎncān fēicháng fēngfù.
B2L09-1-17.english: Because today is Dad's birthday, the dinner is very abundant.

B2L09-1-18.chinese: 那位教授的教法很好，很多學生都想修他的課。
B2L09-1-18.pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu de jiàofǎ hěn hǎo, hěn duō xuéshēng dōu xiǎng xiū tā de kè.
B2L09-1-18.english: That professor's teaching method is very good; many students want to take his course.

B2L09-1-21.chinese: 這次期末的筆試不太難，大家都考得不錯。今天早上考筆試的時候，我寫得太慢了，所以沒寫完。
B2L09-1-21.pinyin: Zhè cì qímò de bǐshì bú tài nán, dàjiā dōu kǎo de búcuò. Jīntiān zǎoshàng kǎo bǐshì de shíhòu, wǒ xiě de tài màn le, suǒyǐ méi xiě wán.
B2L09-1-21.english: This final written exam is not too hard; everyone did pretty well. This morning when I took the written exam, I wrote too slowly, so I didn't finish.

B2L09-1-22.chinese: 這篇作文明天得交給老師，今天晚上一定得寫完。
B2L09-1-22.pinyin: Zhè piān zuòwén míngtiān děi jiāo gěi lǎoshī, jīntiān wǎnshàng yídìng děi xiě wán.
B2L09-1-22.english: This composition must be handed in to the teacher tomorrow; tonight I definitely must finish writing it.

B2L09-1-23.chinese: 這個週末我得在家做一份報告，不能出去玩。
B2L09-1-23.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒ děi zài jiā zuò yí fèn bàogào, bùnéng chūqù wán.
B2L09-1-23.english: This weekend I have to stay home and write a report; I can't go out and have fun.

B2L09-1-24.chinese: 他上課的時候很認真，所以功課一直很好。
B2L09-1-24.pinyin: Tā shàngkè de shíhòu hěn rènzhēn, suǒyǐ gōngkè yìzhí hěn hǎo.
B2L09-1-24.english: He is very conscientious in class, so his schoolwork has always been good.

B2L09-1-25.chinese: 我每次翻譯日文小說的時候，都要查字典。
B2L09-1-25.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì fānyì Rìwén xiǎoshuō de shíhòu, dōu yào chá zìdiǎn.
B2L09-1-25.english: Every time I translate Japanese novels, I need to look up words in the dictionary.

B2L09-1-26.chinese: 這篇文章的中文翻譯翻得很好。
B2L09-1-26.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de Zhōngwén fānyì fān dehěn hǎo.
B2L09-1-26.english: The Chinese translation of this article is translated very well.

B2L09-1-27.chinese: 我每次翻譯日文小說的時候，都要查字典。
B2L09-1-27.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì fānyì Rìwén xiǎoshuō de shíhòu, dōu yào chá zìdiǎn.
B2L09-1-27.english: Every time I translate a Japanese novel, I have to look words up in a dictionary.

B2L09-1-28.chinese: 這次數學期末考的筆試很難，我有四題寫錯了。
B2L09-1-28.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué qímòkǎo de bǐshì hěn nán, wǒ yǒu sì tí xiě cuò le.
B2L09-1-28.english: This math final written exam was very hard; I got four questions wrong.

B2L09-1-29.chinese: 他一直很努力，所以現在當老闆了。
B2L09-1-29.pinyin: Tā yìzhí hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ xiànzài dāng lǎobǎn le.
B2L09-1-29.english: He has always made efforts, so now he has become a boss.

B2L09-1-30.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
B2L09-1-30.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yìdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
B2L09-1-30.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

B2L09-1-31.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
B2L09-1-31.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yìdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
B2L09-1-31.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

B2L09-1-32.chinese: 你的能力夠好，做這個工作一定沒問題。
B2L09-1-32.pinyin: Nǐ de nénglì gòu hǎo, zuò zhè ge gōngzuò yídìng méi wèntí.
B2L09-1-32.english: Your ability is good enough; doing this job will definitely be no problem.

B2L09-1-33.chinese: 他明天要參加籃球比賽，我們去幫他加油吧！
B2L09-1-33.pinyin: Tā míngtiān yào cānjiā lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù bāng tā jiāyóu ba!
B2L09-1-33.english: He is going to participate in a basketball game tomorrow; let's go cheer him on!

B2L09-2-02.chinese: 我跟華語文中心的美國學生語言交換，他教我英文，我教他中文。
B2L09-2-02.pinyin: Wǒ gēn Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn de Měiguó xuéshēng yǔyán jiāohuàn, tā jiāo wǒ Yīngwén, wǒ jiāo tā Zhōngwén.
B2L09-2-02.english: I do a language exchange with an American student at the Mandarin Training Center; he teaches me English, and I teach him Chinese.

B2L09-2-03.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
B2L09-2-03.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
B2L09-2-03.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

B2L09-2-04.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
B2L09-2-04.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
B2L09-2-04.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

B2L09-2-05.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
B2L09-2-05.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
B2L09-2-05.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

B2L09-2-07.chinese: 老師把這個生字清楚地寫在黑板上。
B2L09-2-07.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ zhège shēngzì qīngchǔ de xiě zài hēibǎn shàng.
B2L09-2-07.english: The teacher clearly wrote this new vocabulary word on the blackboard.

B2L09-2-08.chinese: 很多外國學生弄不清楚漢字的聲調。
B2L09-2-08.pinyin: Hěn duō wàiguó xuéshēng nòng bù qīngchǔ Hànzì de shēngdiào.
B2L09-2-08.english: Many foreign students cannot get the tones of Chinese characters clear.

B2L09-2-09.chinese: 老師說得寫了生字、造了句，才可以下課。
B2L09-2-09.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō de xiě le shēngzì, zào le jù, cái kěyǐ xiàkè.
B2L09-2-09.english: The teacher said that only after writing the new vocabulary and making sentences can we leave class.

B2L09-2-10.chinese: 上中文課時，老師要我們用中文報告在台灣的生活。
B2L09-2-10.pinyin: Shàng Zhōngwén kè shí, lǎoshī yào wǒmen yòng Zhōngwén bàogào zài Táiwān de shēnghuó.
B2L09-2-10.english: In Chinese class, the teacher wants us to report in Chinese on our life in Taiwan.

B2L09-2-11.chinese: 那個外國學生常跟台灣朋友聊天，用中文表達自己的意見。
B2L09-2-11.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó xuéshēng cháng gēn Táiwān péngyǒu liáotiān, yòng Zhōngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
B2L09-2-11.english: That foreign student often chats with Taiwanese friends, expressing his own opinions in Chinese.

B2L09-2-12.chinese: 那個外國學生常跟台灣朋友聊天，用中文表達自己的意見。
B2L09-2-12.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó xuéshēng cháng gēn Táiwān péngyǒu liáotiān, yòng Zhōngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
B2L09-2-12.english: That foreign student often chats with Taiwanese friends, expressing his own opinions in Chinese.

B2L09-2-13.chinese: 這篇作文的錯字太多了，所以分數不高。
B2L09-2-13.pinyin: Zhè piān zuòwén de cuòzì tài duō le, suǒyǐ fēnshù bù gāo.
B2L09-2-13.english: This essay has too many wrong characters, so the score is not high.

B2L09-2-14.chinese: 他在台灣交了很多朋友，每天都過得很開心。
B2L09-2-14.pinyin: Tā zài Táiwān jiāo le hěn duō péngyǒu, měitiān dōu guò dehěn kāixīn.
B2L09-2-14.english: He has made a lot of friends in Taiwan and is happy every day.

B2L09-2-15.chinese: 我覺得「把」的語法很難，造句的時候常弄錯。
B2L09-2-15.pinyin: Wǒ juéde “bǎ” de yǔfǎ hěn nán, zàojù de shíhòu cháng nòngcuò.
B2L09-2-15.english: I think the grammar of “bǎ” is very difficult; when making sentences, I often get it wrong.

B2L09-2-16.chinese: 這本書只能借到下個禮拜一，再看兩天就得還了。
B2L09-2-16.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhǐ néng jiè dào xià ge lǐbài yī, zài kàn liǎng tiān jiù děi huán le.
B2L09-2-16.english: This book can only be borrowed until next Monday; after reading it for two more days, I will have to return it.

B2L09-2-17.chinese: 這本書只能借到下個禮拜一，再看兩天就得還了。
B2L09-2-17.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhǐ néng jiè dào xià ge lǐbài yī, zài kàn liǎng tiān jiù děi huán le.
B2L09-2-17.english: This book can only be borrowed until next Monday; after reading it for two more days, I will have to return it.

B2L09-2-18.chinese: 外國人覺得台灣人很好，迷路時，都會有人告訴他們怎麼走。
B2L09-2-18.pinyin: Wàiguórén juéde Táiwān rén hěn hǎo, mílù shí, dōu huì yǒu rén gàosu tāmen zěnme zǒu.
B2L09-2-18.english: Foreigners feel that Taiwanese people are very nice; when they get lost, there is always someone to tell them how to go.

B2L09-2-19.chinese: 黃小姐生日那天，男朋友送給她九百九十九朵玫瑰花，讓她感動得不得了。
B2L09-2-19.pinyin: Huáng xiǎojiě shēngrì nà tiān, nánpéngyǒu sòng gěi tā jiǔbǎijiǔshíjiǔ duǒ méiguihuā, ràng tā gǎndòng de bùdéliǎo.
B2L09-2-19.english: On Miss Huang's birthday, her boyfriend gave her 999 roses, which moved her incredibly.

B2L09-2-20.chinese: 他很煩惱，不知道畢業以後要找什麼工作。
B2L09-2-20.pinyin: Tā hěn fánnǎo, bù zhīdào bìyè yǐhòu yào zhǎo shénme gōngzuò.
B2L09-2-20.english: He is very worried, not knowing what job to look for after graduation.

B2L09-2-21.chinese: 我想趁著暑假去旅行，你有什麼建議？
B2L09-2-21.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chènzhe shǔjià qù lǚxíng, nǐ yǒu shénme jiànyì?
B2L09-2-21.english: I want to take a trip during the summer vacation. Do you have any suggestions?

B2L10-1-02.chinese: 最近天氣變得很冷，所以我常常頭痛。
B2L10-1-02.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì biàn de hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ chángcháng tóutòng.
B2L10-1-02.english: Recently the weather has become very cold, so I often have headaches.

B2L10-1-03.chinese: 我吃了不乾淨的東西，今天就拉了三次肚子了。
B2L10-1-03.pinyin: Wǒ chī le bù gānjìng de dōngxi, jīntiān jiù lā le sān cì dùzi le.
B2L10-1-03.english: I ate something unclean, and today I have already had diarrhea three times.

B2L10-1-04.chinese: 我這幾天背很疼，看了兩次病了，還是不舒服。
B2L10-1-04.pinyin: Wǒ zhèjǐtiān bèi hěn téng, kàn le liǎng cì bìng le, háishì bù shūfu.
B2L10-1-04.english: My back has hurt a lot these past few days. I've seen a doctor twice and still don't feel well.

B2L10-1-05.chinese: 你上班老是遲到，老闆不生氣嗎？
B2L10-1-05.pinyin: Nǐ shàngbān lǎoshì chídào, lǎobǎn bù shēngqì ma?
B2L10-1-05.english: You are always late for work; isn't your boss angry?

B2L10-1-06.chinese: 這件衣服太大了，請你幫我改小一點兒。
B2L10-1-06.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu tài dà le, qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ gǎi xiǎo yìdiǎnr.
B2L10-1-06.english: This piece of clothing is too big; please help me alter it to be a little smaller.

B2L10-1-07.chinese: 他每天都去健身房健身，所以身體很好。
B2L10-1-07.pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu qù jiànshēnfáng jiànshēn, suǒyǐ shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
B2L10-1-07.english: He works out at the gym every day, so he is in good health.

B2L10-1-08.chinese: 陳小姐從小就愛史努比，所以臥房裡到處都是史努比的娃娃。
B2L10-1-08.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù ài Shǐnǔbǐ, suǒyǐ wòfáng lǐ dàochù dōu shì Shǐnǔbǐ de wáwa.
B2L10-1-08.english: Miss Chen has loved Snoopy since childhood, so there are Snoopy dolls everywhere in her bedroom.

B2L10-1-13.chinese: 我去義大利旅行的時候，不小心把護照弄丟了，我擔心死了。
B2L10-1-13.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yìdàlì lǚxíng de shíhòu, bù xiǎoxīn bǎ hùzhào nòng diū le, wǒ dānxīn sǐ le.
B2L10-1-13.english: When I was traveling in Italy, I accidentally lost my passport; I was worried to death.

B2L10-1-14.chinese: 聽說你昨天吃了五盤芒果冰，太誇張了吧！
B2L10-1-14.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ zuótiān chī le wǔ pán mángguǒ bīng, tài kuāzhāng le ba!
B2L10-1-14.english: I heard you ate five plates of mango shaved ice yesterday. That's way too much!

B2L10-1-17.chinese: 我沒點滷肉飯，他們送錯了。陳先生每天都開車送孩子去學校。
B2L10-1-17.pinyin: Wǒ méi diǎn lǔròu fàn, tāmen sòng cuò le. Chén xiānshēng měitiān dōu kāichē sòng háizi qù xuéxiào.
B2L10-1-17.english: I didn't order braised pork rice; they delivered the wrong order. Mr. Chen drives his children to school every day.

B2L10-1-18.chinese: 救護車開得很快，因為要救人一命。
B2L10-1-18.pinyin: Jiùhùchē kāi dehěn kuài, yīnwèi yào jiù rén yí mìng.
B2L10-1-18.english: The ambulance drove very fast, because it needed to save a person's life.

B2L10-1-19.chinese: 那個孩子受了傷，好像快死了，媽媽請醫生快點兒救救他。
B2L10-1-19.pinyin: Nàge háizi shòu le shāng, hǎoxiàng kuài sǐ le, māma qǐng yīshēng kuài diǎnr jiù jiù tā.
B2L10-1-19.english: That child got hurt and seemed close to dying; the mother asked the doctor to save him quickly.

B2L10-1-20.chinese: 很多父母希望孩子照他們的意思做，因為怕孩子自己做不好。
B2L10-1-20.pinyin: Hěn duō fùmǔ xīwàng háizi zhào tāmen de yìsi zuò, yīnwèi pà háizi zìjǐ zuò bùhǎo.
B2L10-1-20.english: Many parents hope their children will do things according to their wishes, because they are afraid the children won't do well on their own.

B2L10-1-22.chinese: 隔壁的王媽媽化妝以後，變年輕了。
B2L10-1-22.pinyin: Gébì de Wáng māma huàzhuāng yǐhòu, biàn niánqīng le.
B2L10-1-22.english: After putting on makeup, Mrs. Wang next door became younger.

B2L10-1-24.chinese: 我最近每天運動，體重減了兩公斤。
B2L10-1-24.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn měitiān yùndòng, tǐzhòng jiǎn le liǎng gōngjīn.
B2L10-1-24.english: I have been exercising every day recently, and I have lost two kilograms.

B2L10-1-25.chinese: 他身體不好，只跳了幾下就覺得好累。
B2L10-1-25.pinyin: Tā shēntǐ bùhǎo, zhǐ tiào le jǐ xià jiù juéde hǎo lèi.
B2L10-1-25.english: He is not in good health; after jumping only a few times he already felt very tired.

B2L10-1-26.chinese: 我大哥今年三十歲了，我們的年紀差了十歲。
B2L10-1-26.pinyin: Wǒ dàgē jīnnián sānshí suì le, wǒmen de niánjì chà le shí suì.
B2L10-1-26.english: My oldest brother is thirty years old this year; there is a ten-year age difference between us.

B2L10-1-29.chinese: 那個老人年紀太大，沒辦法一個人生活。
B2L10-1-29.pinyin: Nàge lǎorén niánjì tài dà, méibànfǎ yígerén shēnghuó.
B2L10-1-29.english: That old man is too old; he has no way to live by himself.

B2L10-1-34.chinese: 張先生的飲食習慣很好，加上常運動，所以身體很健康。
B2L10-1-34.pinyin: Zhāng xiānshēng de yǐnshí xíguàn hěn hǎo, jiāshàng cháng yùndòng, suǒyǐ shēntǐ hěn jiànkāng.
B2L10-1-34.english: Mr. Zhang has very good eating habits, and he also exercises often, so he is very healthy.

B2L10-1-36.chinese: 這個菜放了太多鹽，鹹死了。
B2L10-1-36.pinyin: Zhège cài fàng le tài duō yán, xián sǐ le.
B2L10-1-36.english: This dish has too much salt in it; it's salty to death.

B2L10-1-38.chinese: 運動以後最好喝開水，不要喝太甜的飲料。
B2L10-1-38.pinyin: Yùndòng yǐhòu zuìhǎo hē kāishuǐ, búyào hē tài tián de yǐnliào.
B2L10-1-38.english: After exercising, it's best to drink boiled water, not drinks that are too sweet.

B2L10-1-39.chinese: 電影三點開始，現在是兩點五十分，一定來不及了。
B2L10-1-39.pinyin: Diànyǐng sān diǎn kāishǐ, xiànzài shì liǎng diǎn wǔshí fēn, yídìng láibùjí le.
B2L10-1-39.english: The movie starts at three and it is 2:50 now, so we definitely won't make it in time.

B2L10-1-41.chinese: 他不會做飯，所以三餐都在外面吃。
B2L10-1-41.pinyin: Tā bú huì zuòfàn, suǒyǐ sāncān dōu zài wàimiàn chī.
B2L10-1-41.english: He doesn't know how to cook, so he eats all three meals out.

B2L10-1-42.chinese: 他不會做飯，所以三餐都在外面吃。
B2L10-1-42.pinyin: Tā bú huì zuòfàn, suǒyǐ sāncān dōu zài wàimiàn chī.
B2L10-1-42.english: He doesn't know how to cook, so he eats all three meals out.

B2L10-1-44.chinese: 你剛剛說要吃漢堡，現在說要吃炸雞，到底要吃什麼？
B2L10-1-44.pinyin: Nǐ gānggāng shuō yào chī hànbǎo, xiànzài shuō yào chī zhàjī, dàodǐ yào chī shénme?
B2L10-1-44.english: You just said you wanted to eat a hamburger, and now you say you want to eat fried chicken—what on earth do you want to eat?

B2L10-1-45.chinese: 這個用活魚做的菜又新鮮又好吃。
B2L10-1-45.pinyin: Zhège yòng huó yú zuò de cài yòu xīnxiān yòu hǎochī.
B2L10-1-45.english: This dish made with live fish is both fresh and delicious.

B2L10-1-46.chinese: 健身教練訓練我慢跑，希望我越跑越健康。
B2L10-1-46.pinyin: Jiànshēn jiàoliàn xùnliàn wǒ mànpǎo, xīwàng wǒ yuè pǎo yuè jiànkāng.
B2L10-1-46.english: The fitness coach trains me to jog, hoping that the more I run, the healthier I will become.

B2L10-1-47.chinese: 健身教練訓練我慢跑，希望我越跑越健康。
B2L10-1-47.pinyin: Jiànshēn jiàoliàn xùnliàn wǒ mànpǎo, xīwàng wǒ yuè pǎo yuè jiànkāng.
B2L10-1-47.english: The fitness coach trains me to jog, hoping that the more I run, the healthier I will become.

B2L10-2-01.chinese: 吃太多餅乾、薯條，只有壞處沒有好處。
B2L10-2-01.pinyin: Chī tài duō bǐnggān, shǔtiáo, zhǐyǒu huàichù méiyǒu hǎochù.
B2L10-2-01.english: Eating too many cookies and French fries has only disadvantages and no benefits.

B2L10-2-02.chinese: 吃太多餅乾、薯條，只有壞處沒有好處。
B2L10-2-02.pinyin: Chī tài duō bǐnggān, shǔtiáo, zhǐyǒu huàichù méiyǒu hǎochù.
B2L10-2-02.english: Eating too many cookies and French fries has only disadvantages and no benefits.

B2L10-2-03.chinese: 他不敢約女生出去，或許是因為太害羞了。
B2L10-2-03.pinyin: Tā bù gǎn yuē nǚshēng chūqù, huòxǔ shì yīnwèi tài hàixiū le.
B2L10-2-03.english: He doesn't dare to ask girls out; perhaps it's because he is too shy.

B2L10-2-04.chinese: 醫生說，經常運動的人，比較不容易生病。
B2L10-2-04.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, jīngcháng yùndòng de rén, bǐjiào bù róngyì shēngbìng.
B2L10-2-04.english: The doctor says that people who usually exercise are less likely to get sick.

B2L10-2-05.chinese: 他的體力很好，每天工作十幾個小時也不累。
B2L10-2-05.pinyin: Tā de tǐlì hěn hǎo, měitiān gōngzuò shíjǐ ge xiǎoshí yě bú lèi.
B2L10-2-05.english: He has great physical strength; he works more than ten hours every day and still isn't tired.

B2L10-2-06.chinese: 小孩子的手比較沒有力，沒辦法拿很重的東西。
B2L10-2-06.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi de shǒu bǐjiào méiyǒu lì, méibànfǎ ná hěn zhòng de dōngxi.
B2L10-2-06.english: Children's hands have relatively little strength; they have no way to carry very heavy things.

B2L10-2-07.chinese: 每天起床後，我一定要喝一杯咖啡才會有精神。
B2L10-2-07.pinyin: Měitiān qǐchuáng hòu, wǒ yídìng yào hē yì bēi kāfēi cái huì yǒu jīngshén.
B2L10-2-07.english: Every day after getting up, I must drink a cup of coffee to have energy.

B2L10-2-08.chinese: 我剛去工作的時候，常常需要同事的幫助。幫助別人讓我覺得很快樂！
B2L10-2-08.pinyin: Wǒ gāng qù gōngzuò de shíhòu, chángcháng xūyào tóngshì de bāngzhù. Bāngzhù biérén ràng wǒ juéde hěn kuàilè!
B2L10-2-08.english: When I first started working, I often needed my colleagues' help. Helping others makes me feel very happy!

B2L10-2-09.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
B2L10-2-09.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
B2L10-2-09.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

B2L10-2-10.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
B2L10-2-10.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
B2L10-2-10.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

B2L10-2-11.chinese: 媽媽說可樂太甜了，不讓我喝第二瓶。
B2L10-2-11.pinyin: Māma shuō kělè tài tián le, bú ràng wǒ hē dì'èr píng.
B2L10-2-11.english: Mom said cola is too sweet and won't let me drink a second bottle.
