B2L10-2-12.chinese: 我下午只有兩堂體育課，下課後就可以回家了。
B2L10-2-12.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ zhǐyǒu liǎng táng tǐyù kè, xiàkè hòu jiù kěyǐ huí jiā le.
B2L10-2-12.english: In the afternoon I only have two PE classes; after class I can go home.

B2L10-2-13.chinese: 健身教練說，等我病好了，體力好一點兒了，就應該繼續慢跑。今天上課上到這裡，明天再繼續吧！
B2L10-2-13.pinyin: Jiànshēn jiàoliàn shuō, děng wǒ bìng hǎo le, tǐlì hǎo yìdiǎnr le, jiù yīnggāi jìxù mànpǎo. Jīntiān shàngkè shàng dào zhèlǐ, míngtiān zài jìxù ba!
B2L10-2-13.english: The fitness coach said that once I recover from my illness and my stamina is a bit better, I should continue jogging. Today's class will stop here; let's continue tomorrow!

B2L10-2-14.chinese: 醫生建議這個病人每天跑步三十分鐘，這樣體力、精神就會越來越好的。
B2L10-2-14.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì zhège bìngrén měitiān pǎobù sān shífēn zhōng, zhèyàng tǐlì, jīngshén jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de.
B2L10-2-14.english: The doctor suggests that this patient run for thirty minutes every day; this way, his stamina and spirit will get better and better.

B2L10-2-15.chinese: 醫生建議這個病人每天游泳游三十分鐘，這樣體力、精神就會越來越好的。
B2L10-2-15.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì zhège bìngrén měitiān yóuyǒng yóu sān shífēn zhōng, zhèyàng tǐlì, jīngshén jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de.
B2L10-2-15.english: The doctor suggests that this patient swim for thirty minutes every day, so that his strength and energy will get better and better.

B2L10-2-17.chinese: 病人應該多休息，才能早一點兒恢復健康。
B2L10-2-17.pinyin: Bìngrén yīnggāi duō xiūxí, cáinéng zǎo yìdiǎnr huīfù jiànkāng.
B2L10-2-17.english: The patient should rest more so that he can recover his health a bit sooner.

B2L10-2-18.chinese: 老人也需要運動，活動一下手跟腳。
B2L10-2-18.pinyin: Lǎorén yě xūyào yùndòng, huódòng yíxià shǒu gēnjiǎo.
B2L10-2-18.english: Older people also need exercise; they should move their hands and feet a bit.

B2L10-2-19.chinese: 我剛買的皮包被小偷偷了，讓我又生氣又難過。
B2L10-2-19.pinyin: Wǒ gāng mǎi de píbāo bèi xiǎo tōutōu le, ràng wǒ yòu shēngqì yòu nánguò.
B2L10-2-19.english: The purse I just bought was stolen by a thief, which made me both angry and sad.

B2L10-2-20.chinese: 那個小孩子年紀太小，不會自己穿衣服、脫褲子。
B2L10-2-20.pinyin: Nàge xiǎoháizi niánjì tài xiǎo, búhuì zìjǐ chuān yīfu, tuō kùzi.
B2L10-2-20.english: That child is too young to put on clothes or take off his pants by himself.

B2L11-1-03.chinese: 我把剛買回來的小說擺在書架上。準備吃飯了，快點兒把碗筷擺好！
B2L11-1-03.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ gāng mǎi huí lái de xiǎoshuō bǎi zài shūjià shàng. Zhǔnbèi chīfàn le, kuài diǎnr bǎ wǎnkuài bǎi hǎo!
B2L11-1-03.english: I placed the novel I just bought on the bookshelf. We're getting ready to eat; quickly set out the bowls and chopsticks!

B2L11-1-06.chinese: 你唱的這首歌真好聽，可以請你再唱一遍嗎？
B2L11-1-06.pinyin: Nǐ chàng de zhè shǒu gē zhēn hǎotīng, kěyǐ qǐng nǐ zài chàng yí biàn ma?
B2L11-1-06.english: This song you sang is really nice; could I ask you to sing it one more time?

B2L11-1-07.chinese: 畢業後要工作還是要繼續念書，我得好好地想想再選擇！
B2L11-1-07.pinyin: Bìyè hòu yào gōngzuò háishì yào jìxù niànshū, wǒ děi hǎohǎo de xiǎng xiǎng zài xuǎnzé!
B2L11-1-07.english: After graduation, whether to work or to continue studying, I must think it over carefully before choosing!

B2L11-1-08.chinese: 媽媽：鹽用完了，幫我去便利商店買一包吧！孩子：好，我立刻去！
B2L11-1-08.pinyin: Māma: Yán yòng wán le, bāng wǒ qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi yì bāo ba! Háizi: Hǎo, wǒ lìkè qù!
B2L11-1-08.english: Mom: The salt is used up; help me go to the convenience store to buy a pack! Child: Okay, I'll go right away!

B2L11-1-11.chinese: 我對這支新手機很感興趣，你能給我介紹介紹嗎？
B2L11-1-11.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè zhī xīn shǒujī hěn gǎnxìngqù, nǐ néng gěi wǒ jièshào jièshào ma?
B2L11-1-11.english: I'm very interested in this new cell phone; can you introduce it to me a bit?

B2L11-1-12.chinese: 中國功夫是一種運動，也是一種藝術。
B2L11-1-12.pinyin: Zhōngguó gōngfu shì yì zhǒng yùndòng, yě shì yì zhǒng yìshù.
B2L11-1-12.english: Chinese kung fu is a kind of sport and also a kind of art.

B2L11-1-14.chinese: 山本良介很厲害，早上剛學的五十個生字全部都記得了！
B2L11-1-14.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè hěn lìhài, zǎoshàng gāng xué de wǔshí ge shēngzì quánbù dōu jìde le!
B2L11-1-14.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke is really impressive; he remembers all fifty new characters he just learned this morning!

B2L11-1-16.chinese: 為了保護我們愛的人，我們得勇敢一點兒。
B2L11-1-16.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù wǒmen ài de rén, wǒmen děi yǒnggǎn yìdiǎnr.
B2L11-1-16.english: In order to protect the people we love, we must be a bit braver.

B2L11-1-21.chinese: 教授說，期末考的筆試比較難，一定要好好地複習。
B2L11-1-21.pinyin: Jiàoshòu shuō, qímòkǎo de bǐshì bǐjiào nán, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de fùxí.
B2L11-1-21.english: The professor said the written exam for the final will be relatively difficult, so you must review well.

B2L11-1-22.chinese: 山本良介跟莫以凡是同一天到台灣的。
B2L11-1-22.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè gēn Mò Yǐfán shì tóng yì tiān dào Táiwān de.
B2L11-1-22.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke and Mo Yifan arrived in Taiwan on the same day.

B2L11-1-24.chinese: 我們都是好同學，應該互相幫助、互相學習。
B2L11-1-24.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu shì hǎo tóngxué, yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù, hùxiāng xuéxí.
B2L11-1-24.english: We are all good classmates; we should help each other and learn from each other.

B2L11-1-25.chinese: 我姐姐跟她先生戀愛了七年才結婚，現在他們的生活幸福極了。
B2L11-1-25.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie gēn tā xiānshēng liàn'ài le qī nián cái jiéhūn, xiànzài tāmen de shēnghuó xìngfú jíle.
B2L11-1-25.english: My older sister dated her husband for seven years before they married, and now their life is extremely happy.

B2L11-2-06.chinese: 我週末都去育幼院照顧沒有父母的孩子。
B2L11-2-06.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò dōu qù yùyòuyuàn zhàogù méiyǒu fùmǔ de háizi.
B2L11-2-06.english: On weekends I go to the orphanage to take care of children without parents.

B2L11-2-07.chinese: 他太晚起床，趕快刷了牙就去上班了。
B2L11-2-07.pinyin: Tā tài wǎn qǐchuáng, gǎnkuài shuā le yá jiù qù shàngbān le.
B2L11-2-07.english: He got up too late; he quickly brushed his teeth and then went to work.

B2L11-2-10.chinese: 每次出國時，機場的安全人員都會檢查我們的護照和行李。
B2L11-2-10.pinyin: Měi cì chūguó shí, jīchǎng de ānquán rényuán dōu huì jiǎnchá wǒmen de hùzhào hé xínglǐ.
B2L11-2-10.english: Every time we go abroad, the airport security staff check our passports and luggage.

B2L11-2-11.chinese: 護理師的工作就是幫助醫生處理病人的問題。
B2L11-2-11.pinyin: Hùlǐshī de gōngzuò jiùshì bāngzhù yīshēng chǔlǐ bìngrén de wèntí.
B2L11-2-11.english: A nurse's job is to help doctors deal with patients' problems.

B2L11-2-12.chinese: 看病以前要先掛號，再照號碼進去看醫生。病人得先掛了號才可以看病。
B2L11-2-12.pinyin: Kànbìng yǐqián yào xiān guàhào, zài zhào hàomǎ jìnqù kàn yīshēng. Bìngrén děi xiān guà le hào cái kěyǐ kànbìng.
B2L11-2-12.english: Before seeing a doctor, you must first register, then go in according to your number to see the doctor. Patients must first register before they can see a doctor.

B2L11-2-15.chinese: 大衣、毛衣、外套等服裝，這家店都賣。學中文，聽、說、讀、寫等四個部分，都需要多練習。
B2L11-2-15.pinyin: Dàyī, máoyī, wàitào děng fúzhuāng, zhè jiā diàn dōu mài. Xué Zhōngwén, tīng, shuō, dú, xiě děng sì ge bùfèn, dōu xūyào duō liànxí.
B2L11-2-15.english: This store sells clothing such as coats, sweaters, and jackets. In learning Chinese, the four parts—listening, speaking, reading, and writing—all require a lot of practice.

B2L11-2-17.chinese: 我的家人非常關心我在國外的生活。
B2L11-2-17.pinyin: Wǒ de jiārén fēicháng guānxīn wǒ zài guówài de shēnghuó.
B2L11-2-17.english: My family is very concerned about my life abroad.

B2L11-2-19.chinese: 像慢跑、游泳那樣的運動，對健康極有幫助。
B2L11-2-19.pinyin: Xiàng mànpǎo, yóuyǒng nàyàng de yùndòng, duì jiànkāng jí yǒu bāngzhù.
B2L11-2-19.english: Sports like jogging and swimming are extremely helpful for health.

B2L11-2-20.chinese: 陳可欣極重視考試的成績，可是她覺得參加社團也會有很多收穫。
B2L11-2-20.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn jí zhòngshì kǎoshì de chéngjī, kěshì tā juéde cānjiā shètuán yě huì yǒu hěn duō shōuhuò.
B2L11-2-20.english: Chen Kexin highly values exam grades, but she feels that joining clubs will also bring many rewards.

B2L11-2-22.chinese: 我父母覺得出國念書才會有美好的未來。
B2L11-2-22.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ juéde chūguó niànshū cái huì yǒu měihǎo de wèilái.
B2L11-2-22.english: My parents think that only by studying abroad will there be a bright future.

B2L11-2-23.chinese: 參加社團活動，是讓自己成長的好機會。孩子出國留學以後，父母發現孩子成長了不少。
B2L11-2-23.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng, shì ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng de hǎo jīhuì. Háizi chūguó liúxué yǐhòu, fùmǔ fāxiàn háizi chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo.
B2L11-2-23.english: Participating in club activities is a good opportunity for personal growth. After their child went abroad to study, the parents found that the child had grown a lot.

B2L11-2-25.chinese: 時間很寶貴，我們應該要趁著年輕多讀書、多學習。
B2L11-2-25.pinyin: Shíjiān hěn bǎoguì, wǒmen yīnggāi yào chènzhe niánqīng duō dúshū, duō xuéxí.
B2L11-2-25.english: Time is precious; we should take advantage of our youth to read more and learn more.

B2L11-2-26.chinese: 利用週末到安養院幫助老人，是很有意義的活動。
B2L11-2-26.pinyin: Lìyòng zhōumò dào ānyǎng yuàn bāngzhù lǎorén, shì hěn yǒu yìyì de huódòng.
B2L11-2-26.english: Using the weekend to go to a nursing home to help the elderly is a very meaningful activity.

B2L12-1-01.chinese: 我以為張先生是那家公司的大老闆，其實他只是個小職員。
B2L12-1-01.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi Zhāng xiānshēng shì nà jiā gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, qíshí tā zhǐshì ge xiǎo zhíyuán.
B2L12-1-01.english: I thought Mr. Zhang was the big boss of that company, but actually he is just a small clerk.

B2L12-1-02.chinese: 我父親的職業是大學教授，母親是郵局的員工。
B2L12-1-02.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn de zhíyè shì dàxué jiàoshòu, mǔqīn shì yóujú de yuángōng.
B2L12-1-02.english: My father's occupation is university professor, and my mother is an employee of the post office.

B2L12-1-04.chinese: 他為了研究環境和文化的關係，用了不少時間。
B2L12-1-04.pinyin: Tā wèile yánjiù huánjìng hé wénhuà de guānxì, yòng le bùshǎo shíjiān.
B2L12-1-04.english: In order to research the relationship between environment and culture, he spent quite a lot of time.

B2L12-1-05.chinese: 王教授推薦我去念那個研究所的翻譯課程。
B2L12-1-05.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu tuījiàn wǒ qù niàn nàge yánjiùsuǒ de fānyì kèchéng.
B2L12-1-05.english: Professor Wang recommended that I go study the translation course at that graduate institute.

B2L12-1-06.chinese: 我接到了健身中心的通知，下個月就要去當健身教練了。
B2L12-1-06.pinyin: Wǒ jiēdào le jiànshēn zhōngxīn de tōngzhī, xià ge yuè jiùyào qù dāng jiànshēn jiàoliàn le.
B2L12-1-06.english: I received a notice from the fitness center; next month I will start working as a fitness coach.

B2L12-1-07.chinese: 那支新手機的廣告做得很好，很多人都被吸引了。
B2L12-1-07.pinyin: Nà zhī xīn shǒujī de guǎnggào zuò dehěn hǎo, hěn duō rén dōu bèi xīyǐn le.
B2L12-1-07.english: The advertisement for that new cell phone was made very well; many people were attracted by it.

B2L12-1-08.chinese: 這件大衣的設計很簡單，可是穿起來很好看。
B2L12-1-08.pinyin: Zhè jiàn dàyī de shèjì hěn jiǎndān, kěshì chuān qǐlái hěn hǎokàn.
B2L12-1-08.english: The design of this coat is very simple, but it looks good when you put it on.

B2L12-1-09.chinese: 開會的時候，老闆請大家把自己的想法說出來。
B2L12-1-09.pinyin: Kāihuì de shíhòu, lǎobǎn qǐng dàjiā bǎ zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ shuōchū lái.
B2L12-1-09.english: During the meeting, the boss asked everyone to say what they think.

B2L12-1-11.chinese: 為了練習英文的聽力和會話，我每天都跟美國朋友聊天。
B2L12-1-11.pinyin: Wèile liànxí Yīngwén de tīnglì hé huìhuà, wǒ měi tiān dōu gēn Měiguó péngyǒu liáotiān.
B2L12-1-11.english: In order to practice English listening and conversation, I chat with American friends every day.

B2L12-1-12.chinese: 那所大學的英文系很有名，你得用功一點兒才考得上。
B2L12-1-12.pinyin: Nà suǒ dàxué de Yīngwén xì hěn yǒumíng, nǐ děi yònggōng yìdiǎnr cái kǎo de shàng.
B2L12-1-12.english: That university's English department is very famous; you have to work a bit harder to be able to get in.

B2L12-1-14.chinese: 這所大學的外語學院有英文系、日文系、德文系和義大利文系。
B2L12-1-14.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué de wàiyǔ xuéyuàn yǒu Yīngwén xì, Rìwén xì, Déwén xì hé Yìdàlì wén xì.
B2L12-1-14.english: This university's College of Foreign Languages has an English department, a Japanese department, a German department, and an Italian department.

B2L12-1-17.chinese: 沒有專業能力的人，想找到好職業是很困難的。
B2L12-1-17.pinyin: Méiyǒu zhuānyè nénglì de rén, xiǎng zhǎodào hǎo zhíyè shì hěn kùnnán de.
B2L12-1-17.english: For people without professional skills, finding a good job is very difficult.

B2L12-1-18.chinese: 從下個月起，飛機票就變貴了。
B2L12-1-18.pinyin: Cóng xià ge yuè qǐ, fēijī piào jiù biàn guì le.
B2L12-1-18.english: Starting from next month, plane tickets will become more expensive.

B2L12-1-20.chinese: 我是陳老闆的助理，每天得向他報告公司的情況。
B2L12-1-20.pinyin: Wǒ shì Chén lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ, měitiān děi xiàng tā bàogào gōngsī de qíngkuàng.
B2L12-1-20.english: I am Boss Chen's assistant; every day I have to report the company's situation to him.

B2L12-1-21.chinese: 那家貿易公司跟美國做生意，職員都得會說英文。
B2L12-1-21.pinyin: Nà jiā màoyì gōngsī gēn Měiguó zuò shēngyì, zhíyuán dōu děi huì shuō Yīngwén.
B2L12-1-21.english: That trade company does business with America, so the employees all have to be able to speak English.

B2L12-1-25.chinese: 我父親是保險公司的經理，要管理很多員工。
B2L12-1-25.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn shì bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ, yào guǎnlǐ hěn duō yuángōng.
B2L12-1-25.english: My father is a manager at an insurance company and has to manage many employees.

B2L12-1-26.chinese: 為了做這個報告，經理已經跟我們開過三次會了。
B2L12-1-26.pinyin: Wèile zuò zhège bàogào, jīnglǐ yǐjīng gēn wǒmen kāi guò sān cì huì le.
B2L12-1-26.english: In order to prepare this report, the manager has already had meetings with us three times.

B2L12-1-28.chinese: 這個星期有很多工作，每天下班後都得加三個小時的班。
B2L12-1-28.pinyin: Zhège xīngqí yǒu hěn duō gōngzuò, měitiān xiàbān hòu dōu de jiā sān ge xiǎoshí de bān.
B2L12-1-28.english: There is a lot of work this week, so every day after work I have to work three hours of overtime.

B2L12-1-29.chinese: 他的工作很忙，不但常常加班，還要做市場研究。
B2L12-1-29.pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò hěn máng, búdàn chángcháng jiābān, háiyào zuò shìchǎng yánjiù.
B2L12-1-29.english: His job is very busy; not only does he often work overtime, he also has to do market research.

B2L12-1-30.chinese: 他去過德國留學，難怪會說德文。
B2L12-1-30.pinyin: Tā qù guò Déguó liúxué, nánguài huì shuō Déwén.
B2L12-1-30.english: He has studied abroad in Germany; no wonder he can speak German.

B2L12-1-31.chinese: 王教授退休以後，每個週末都去育幼院陪孩子讀書。
B2L12-1-31.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu tuìxiū yǐhòu, měi ge zhōumò dōu qù yùyòuyuàn péi háizi dúshū.
B2L12-1-31.english: After Professor Wang retired, every weekend he goes to the orphanage to accompany the children in reading.

B2L12-2-01.chinese: 林老師在日文系教書，他教的是二年級的日語會話。
B2L12-2-01.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī zài Rìwén xì jiāoshū, tā jiāo de shì èr niánjí de Rì yǔ huìhuà.
B2L12-2-01.english: Teacher Lin teaches in the Japanese department; what he teaches is second-year Japanese conversation.

B2L12-2-04.chinese: 我家有一個小花園，媽媽有空就在那裡種花、剪草。
B2L12-2-04.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yíge xiǎo huāyuán, māma yǒukòng jiù zài nàlǐ zhǒng huā, jiǎn cǎo.
B2L12-2-04.english: My home has a small garden; when my mother has free time, she plants flowers and trims the grass there.

B2L12-2-06.chinese: 在那家公司上班的職員，都要穿襯衫、長褲。
B2L12-2-06.pinyin: Zài nà jiā gōngsī shàngbān de zhíyuán, dōu yào chuān chènshān, chángkù.
B2L12-2-06.english: Employees who work at that company all have to wear shirts and long pants.

B2L12-2-07.chinese: 很多大學生都打過工，因為得自己付生活費。
B2L12-2-07.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng dōu dǎ guò gōng, yīnwèi děi zìjǐ fù shēnghuó fèi.
B2L12-2-07.english: Many university students have had part-time jobs because they have to pay their own living expenses.

B2L12-2-09.chinese: 爸爸下班以後，總是先洗個澡、喝個飲料，再吃晚飯。
B2L12-2-09.pinyin: Bàba xiàbān yǐhòu, zǒngshì xiān xǐ ge zǎo, hē ge yǐnliào, zài chī wǎnfàn.
B2L12-2-09.english: After work, Dad always first takes a shower, has a drink, and then eats dinner.

B2L12-2-10.chinese: 今天晚上老闆請客，我得穿正式一點兒的服裝。
B2L12-2-10.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshàng lǎobǎn qǐngkè, wǒ děi chuān zhèngshì yìdiǎnr de fúzhuāng.
B2L12-2-10.english: Tonight the boss is treating us, so I have to wear somewhat formal clothing.

B2L12-2-11.chinese: 我覺得把錢存在銀行比放在家裡安全多了。
B2L12-2-11.pinyin: Wǒ juéde bǎ qián cúnzài yínháng bǐ fàng zài jiā lǐ ānquán duō le.
B2L12-2-11.english: I think saving money in the bank is much safer than keeping it at home.

B2L12-2-13.chinese: 同事都走了，只剩下他一個人還在做事。他是廣告公司的經理，每天要做好多事，忙得不得了。
B2L12-2-13.pinyin: Tóngshì dōu zǒu le, zhǐ shèngxià tā yígerén hái zài zuòshì. Tā shì guǎnggào gōngsī de jīnglǐ, měitiān yào zuò hǎo duō shì, máng de bùdéliǎo.
B2L12-2-13.english: The colleagues have all left; only he is left still working. He is a manager at an advertising company; every day he has to do a lot of work and is incredibly busy.

B2L12-2-14.chinese: 我參加了愛心服務社以後，想法比以前更成熟了。香蕉還沒成熟的時候是綠色的，等變成黃色就熟了。
B2L12-2-14.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le àixīn fúwù shè yǐhòu, xiǎngfǎ bǐ yǐqián gèng chéngshú le. Xiāngjiāo háiméi chéngshú de shíhòu shì lǜsè de, děng biànchéng huángsè jiù shóu le.
B2L12-2-14.english: After I joined the volunteer service club, my thinking has become more mature than before. When bananas are not yet ripe, they are green; when they turn yellow, they are ripe.

B2L12-2-15.chinese: 陳小姐的工作能力很強，難怪可以當老闆的助理。
B2L12-2-15.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, nánguài kěyǐ dāng lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ.
B2L12-2-15.english: Miss Chen's work ability is very strong; no wonder she can be the boss's assistant.

B2L12-2-16.chinese: 要是你想出國留學，一定得加強外語能力。
B2L12-2-16.pinyin: Yàoshì nǐ xiǎng chūguó liúxué, yídìng děi jiāqiáng wàiyǔ nénglì.
B2L12-2-16.english: If you want to study abroad, you definitely have to strengthen your foreign language ability.

B2L12-2-18.chinese: 弟弟昨天夜裡兩點才睡覺，難怪早上起不來。
B2L12-2-18.pinyin: Dìdi zuótiān yèlǐ liǎng diǎn cái shuìjiào, nánguài zǎoshàng qǐ bù lái.
B2L12-2-18.english: My younger brother didn't go to sleep until two o'clock last night; no wonder he couldn't get up in the morning.

B2L12-2-19.chinese: 陳可欣是一個勇敢、樂觀的人，什麼麻煩、困難的問題都不怕。
B2L12-2-19.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn shì yíge yǒnggǎn, lèguān de rén, shénme máfán, kùnnán de wèntí dōu bú pà.
B2L12-2-19.english: Chen Kexin is a brave and optimistic person; she is not afraid of any troublesome or difficult problems.

B2L12-2-20.chinese: 我相信，有專業能力的人比較容易找到好工作。
B2L12-2-20.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn, yǒu zhuānyè nénglì de rén bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò.
B2L12-2-20.english: I believe that people with professional ability find good jobs more easily.

B2L12-2-21.chinese: 大學給我一封正式的信，通知我得到獎學金了。
B2L12-2-21.pinyin: Dàxué gěi wǒ yì fēng zhèngshì de xìn, tōngzhī wǒ dédào jiǎngxuéjīn le.
B2L12-2-21.english: The university gave me a formal letter notifying me that I have received a scholarship.

B2L13-1-06.chinese: 請你說明一下，這些產品的功能有什麼差別？
B2L13-1-06.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shuōmíng yíxià, zhèxiē chǎnpǐn de gōngnéng yǒu shénme chābié?
B2L13-1-06.english: Please explain, what differences are there in the functions of these products?

B2L13-1-07.chinese: 這些筆電和平板都比以前的輕。
B2L13-1-07.pinyin: Zhèxiē bǐdiàn hé píngbǎn dōu bǐ yǐqián de qīng.
B2L13-1-07.english: These laptops and tablets are all lighter than previous ones.

B2L13-1-08.chinese: 他這次到美國去出差，幫公司處理了不少問題。
B2L13-1-08.pinyin: Tā zhè cì dào Měiguó qù chūchāi, bāng gōngsī chǔlǐ le bùshǎo wèntí.
B2L13-1-08.english: He went on a business trip to the US this time and handled quite a few problems for the company.

B2L13-1-09.chinese: A:我好渴，想喝可樂或是冰奶茶。 B:那些飲料都太甜了，不如喝水，這樣比較健康。
B2L13-1-09.pinyin: A: Wǒ hǎo kě, xiǎng hē kělè huòshì bīng nǎichá. B: Nàxiē yǐnliào dōu tài tián le, bùrú hē shuǐ, zhèyàng bǐjiào jiànkāng.
B2L13-1-09.english: A: I'm so thirsty. I want to drink cola or iced milk tea. B: Those drinks are all too sweet. We'd better drink water; that's healthier.

B2L13-1-12.chinese: 不管大人還是小孩，大多數的人都喜歡流行的東西。
B2L13-1-12.pinyin: Bùguǎn dàrén háishì xiǎohái, dàduōshù de rén dōu xǐhuān liúxíng de dōngxi.
B2L13-1-12.english: No matter adults or children, most people like trendy things.

B2L13-1-13.chinese: 那隻貓一直跟著我，真奇怪。
B2L13-1-13.pinyin: Nà zhī māo yìzhí gēn zhe wǒ, zhēn qíguài.
B2L13-1-13.english: That cat keeps following me—how strange.

B2L13-1-14.chinese: 我覺得電腦不比手機好用。
B2L13-1-14.pinyin: Wǒ juéde diànnǎo bù bǐ shǒujī hǎoyòng.
B2L13-1-14.english: I think computers are not as useful as cell phones.

B2L13-1-17.chinese: 電視新聞說，最近有很多人抱怨手機的電池有問題。
B2L13-1-17.pinyin: Diànshì xīnwén shuō, zuìjìn yǒu hěn duō rén bàoyuàn shǒujī de diànchí yǒu wèntí.
B2L13-1-17.english: TV news says that recently many people have complained that cell phone batteries have problems.

B2L13-1-18.chinese: 我的平板最近不太正常，才用了一個鐘頭就沒電了。
B2L13-1-18.pinyin: Wǒ de píngbǎn zuìjìn bú tài zhèngcháng, cái yòng le yíge zhōngtóu jiù méi diàn le.
B2L13-1-18.english: My tablet hasn't been quite normal lately—it ran out of power after only one hour of use.

B2L13-1-19.chinese: 你說這部筆電可以用三年，你能給我什麼保證？
B2L13-1-19.pinyin: Nǐ shuō zhè bù bǐdiàn kěyǐ yòng sān nián, nǐ néng gěi wǒ shénme bǎozhèng?
B2L13-1-19.english: You say this laptop can be used for three years—what guarantee can you give me?

B2L13-1-20.chinese: 你得把保證書帶來，我們才能幫你免費修理電腦。
B2L13-1-20.pinyin: Nǐ děi bǎ bǎozhèngshū dàilái, wǒmen cáinéng bāng nǐ miǎnfèi xiūlǐ diànnǎo.
B2L13-1-20.english: You have to bring the warranty, and only then can we help you repair the computer for free.

B2L13-1-21.chinese: 這麼多問題，今天恐怕討論不完，我們能不能改天再說？
B2L13-1-21.pinyin: Zhème duō wèntí, jīntiān kǒngpà tǎolùn bù wán, wǒmen néng bùnéng gǎitiān zàishuō?
B2L13-1-21.english: With so many problems, I'm afraid we won't be able to finish discussing them today—can we talk about it another day?

B2L13-1-22.chinese: 這麼多問題，今天恐怕討論不完，我們能不能改天再說？
B2L13-1-22.pinyin: Zhème duō wèntí, jīntiān kǒngpà tǎolùn bù wán, wǒmen néng bùnéng gǎitiān zàishuō?
B2L13-1-22.english: With so many problems, I'm afraid we won't be able to finish discussing them today—can we talk about it another day?

B2L13-1-27.chinese: 這個週末以前，超過三千塊錢的東西都可以打九折，請把握機會。
B2L13-1-27.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò yǐqián, chāoguò sānqiān kuài qián de dōngxi dōu kěyǐ dǎ jiǔzhé, qǐng bǎwò jīhuì.
B2L13-1-27.english: Before this weekend, anything over 3,000 dollars is 10% off—please seize the opportunity.

B2L13-1-29.chinese: 我花了大約兩萬塊錢學做法國菜，希望能夠快點兒學會。
B2L13-1-29.pinyin: Wǒ huā le dàyuē liǎngwàn kuài qián xué zuò Fǎguó cài, xīwàng nénggòu kuài diǎnr xuéhuì.
B2L13-1-29.english: I spent about 20,000 dollars learning to cook French cuisine, hoping to be able to learn it quickly.

B2L13-1-30.chinese: 他說的話不一定是真的，你別相信他。
B2L13-1-30.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà bù yídìng shì zhēnde, nǐ bié xiāngxìn tā.
B2L13-1-30.english: What he says isn't necessarily true—don't believe him.

B2L13-2-01.chinese: 我跟朋友打聽附近有沒有房子出租。
B2L13-2-01.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyǒu dǎtīng fùjìn yǒu méiyǒu fángzi chūzū.
B2L13-2-01.english: I asked my friend to inquire whether there are any houses for rent nearby.

B2L13-2-02.chinese: A:這麼晚了，你別喝咖啡，要不然會睡不著。 B:你說得很有道理，那我喝水吧。
B2L13-2-02.pinyin: A: Zhème wǎn le, nǐ bié hē kāfēi, yàobùrán huì shuì bùzháo. B: Nǐ shuō dehěn yǒudàolǐ, nà wǒ hē shuǐ ba.
B2L13-2-02.english: A: It's so late. Don't drink coffee, or you won't be able to sleep. B: You make a good point. Then I'll drink water.

B2L13-2-03.chinese: 教授說了很多哲學的道理，我覺得很難懂。
B2L13-2-03.pinyin: Jiàoshòu shuō le hěn duō zhéxué de dàolǐ, wǒ juéde hěn nán dǒng.
B2L13-2-03.english: The professor talked about many philosophical principles—I find them hard to understand.

B2L13-2-04.chinese: 快考試了，這本書的前幾課我已經複習完了，可是沒時間念後三課。
B2L13-2-04.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zhè běn shū de qián jǐ kè wǒ yǐjīng fùxí wán le, kěshì méi shíjiān niàn hòu sān kè.
B2L13-2-04.english: The exam is coming soon—I've already finished reviewing the first few lessons of this book, but I don't have time to study the last three lessons.

B2L13-2-05.chinese: 快考試了，這本書的前幾課我已經複習完了，可是沒時間念後三課。
B2L13-2-05.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zhè běn shū de qián jǐ kè wǒ yǐjīng fùxí wán le, kěshì méi shíjiān niàn hòu sān kè.
B2L13-2-05.english: The exam is coming soon—I've already finished reviewing the first few lessons of this book, but I don't have time to study the last three lessons.

B2L13-2-07.chinese: 我認為跟平板比起來，筆電的功能比較好。
B2L13-2-07.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi gēn píngbǎn bǐ qǐlái, bǐdiàn de gōngnéng bǐ jiào hǎo.
B2L13-2-07.english: I think that compared with tablets, laptops have better functions.

B2L13-2-08.chinese: 平板越輕、功能越多，價格就越高。
B2L13-2-08.pinyin: Píngbǎn yuè qīng, gōngnéng yuè duō, jiàgé jiù yuè gāo.
B2L13-2-08.english: The lighter the tablet and the more functions it has, the higher the price.

B2L13-2-09.chinese: 我最近窮死了，連三明治也吃不起，只好跟朋友借錢。
B2L13-2-09.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn qióng sǐ le, lián sānmíngzhì yě chī bù qǐ, zhǐhǎo gēn péngyǒu jièqián.
B2L13-2-09.english: I've been dirt poor lately. I can't even afford a sandwich, so I have to borrow money from friends.

B2L13-2-11.chinese: 他非常不愛惜自己的東西，所以東西常不見。
B2L13-2-11.pinyin: Tā fēicháng bú àixí zìjǐ de dōngxi, suǒyǐ dōngxi cháng bújiàn.
B2L13-2-11.english: He doesn't cherish his own things at all, so his things often go missing.

B2L13-2-12.chinese: 我父母每個月都給我三千塊的零用錢。
B2L13-2-12.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ měi ge yuè dōu gěi wǒ sānqiān kuài de língyòngqián.
B2L13-2-12.english: My parents give me 3,000 dollars of pocket money every month.

B2L13-2-13.chinese: 別逼孩子做他們沒興趣或是不喜歡的事情。
B2L13-2-13.pinyin: Bié bī háizi zuò tāmen méi xìngqù huòshì bù xǐhuān de shìqíng.
B2L13-2-13.english: Don't force children to do things they're not interested in or don't like.

B2L13-2-14.chinese: 他很愛惜東西，所以東西都能用很久，省了不少錢。
B2L13-2-14.pinyin: Tā hěn àixí dōngxi, suǒyǐ dōngxi dōu néng yòng hěn jiǔ, shěng le bùshǎo qián.
B2L13-2-14.english: He really cherishes things, so things can all be used for a long time, and he has saved quite a bit of money.

B2L13-2-15.chinese: 我答應朋友去 KTV 幫他過生日，沒想到當天我太忙，忘了這件事。
B2L13-2-15.pinyin: Wǒ dāyìng péngyǒu qù KTV bāng tā guò shēngrì, méixiǎngdào dāngtiān wǒ tài máng, wàngle zhè jiàn shì.
B2L13-2-15.english: I promised my friend I would go to KTV to celebrate his birthday, but I was too busy that day and forgot about it.

B2L13-2-16.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點兒就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
B2L13-2-16.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎnr jiù wàngle zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
B2L13-2-16.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cell phone—so forgetful!

B2L13-2-17.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點兒就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
B2L13-2-17.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎnr jiù wàngle zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
B2L13-2-17.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cellphone. How forgetful!

B2L13-2-18.chinese: 新電腦有問題，給他很多麻煩，讓他覺得白花錢了。
B2L13-2-18.pinyin: Xīn diànnǎo yǒu wèntí, gěi tā hěn duō máfán, ràng tā juéde bái huā qián le.
B2L13-2-18.english: The new computer has problems and gave him a lot of trouble, making him feel he spent money for nothing.

B2L13-2-19.chinese: 新電腦有問題，給他很多麻煩，讓他覺得白花錢了。
B2L13-2-19.pinyin: Xīn diànnǎo yǒu wèntí, gěi tā hěn duō máfán, ràng tā juéde bái huā qián le.
B2L13-2-19.english: The new computer has problems and gave him a lot of trouble, making him feel he spent money for nothing.

B2L13-2-20.chinese: 因為科技越來越進步了，所以生活也變得更便利了。
B2L13-2-20.pinyin: Yīnwèi kējì yuè lái yuè jìnbù le, suǒyǐ shēnghuó yě biàn de gèng biànlì le.
B2L13-2-20.english: Because technology is becoming more and more advanced, life has also become more convenient.

B2L13-2-21.chinese: 月亮上面沒有動物，這是 1969 年科學的新發現。
B2L13-2-21.pinyin: Yuèliàng shàngmiàn méiyǒu dòngwù, zhè shì 1969 nián kēxué de xīn fāxiàn.
B2L13-2-21.english: There are no animals on the moon. This was a new scientific discovery in 1969.

B2L13-2-22.chinese: 現在的科技非常進步，能幫我們解決很多問題。
B2L13-2-22.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì fēicháng jìnbù, néng bāng wǒmen jiějué hěn duō wèntí.
B2L13-2-22.english: Today's technology is very advanced and can help us solve many problems.

B2L14-1-01.chinese: 在春節的前一天，大多數的華人都會回到父母家一起慶祝。
B2L14-1-01.pinyin: Zài Chūnjié de qián yì tiān, dàduōshù de Huárén dōu huì huí dào fùmǔ jiā yìqǐ qìngzhù.
B2L14-1-01.english: On the day before the Spring Festival, most Chinese people return to their parents' home to celebrate together.

B2L14-1-02.chinese: 老師的要求很多，要寫五篇報告、三篇作文，怎麼寫得完？
B2L14-1-02.pinyin: Lǎoshī de yāoqiú hěn duō, yào xiě wǔ piān bàogào, sān piān zuòwén, zěnme xiě de wán?
B2L14-1-02.english: The teacher's requirements are many: write five reports and three essays—how can one finish writing them?

B2L14-1-03.chinese: 我把這篇作文修改好了，明天就可以交給老師了。
B2L14-1-03.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhè piān zuòwén xiūgǎi hǎo le, míngtiān jiù kěyǐ jiāo gěi lǎoshī le.
B2L14-1-03.english: I have revised this essay, so I can hand it to the teacher tomorrow.

B2L14-1-04.chinese: 等我完成期末報告，就要跟同學去韓國旅遊。
B2L14-1-04.pinyin: Děng wǒ wánchéng qímò bàogào, jiùyào gēn tóngxué qù Hánguó lǚyóu.
B2L14-1-04.english: After I finish my final report, I will go traveling to Korea with my classmates.

B2L14-1-05.chinese: 當寒假一到，大家就準備要過年了。
B2L14-1-05.pinyin: Dāng hánjià yí dào, dàjiā jiù zhǔnbèi yào guònián le.
B2L14-1-05.english: When winter vacation arrives, everyone starts getting ready for the New Year.

B2L14-1-06.chinese: 媽媽說要把房間打掃得乾乾淨淨的，這樣才能開開心心地過年。
B2L14-1-06.pinyin: Māma shuō yào bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de gān gānjìng jìng de, zhèyàng cáinéng kāi kāixīn xīn de guònián.
B2L14-1-06.english: Mom said to clean the room spotlessly clean, so that we can celebrate the New Year happily.

B2L14-1-08.chinese: 你剛吃完二十個餃子，就接著吃小籠包，真的吃得下嗎？
B2L14-1-08.pinyin: Nǐ gāng chī wán èrshí ge jiǎozi, jiù jiēzhe chī xiǎolóngbāo, zhēnde chī de xià ma?
B2L14-1-08.english: You just finished eating twenty dumplings, and then you are going to eat soup dumplings—can you really eat more?

B2L14-1-13.chinese: 去那座寺廟拜拜的人真多，他們在拜什麼？
B2L14-1-13.pinyin: Qù nà zuò sìmiào bàibài de rén zhēn duō, tāmen zài bài shénme?
B2L14-1-13.english: There are really many people going to that temple to worship—what are they worshipping?

B2L14-1-14.chinese: 除夕那一天，要拜完祖先才能吃年夜飯。
B2L14-1-14.pinyin: Chúxī nà yì tiān, yào bài wán zǔxiān cáinéng chī niányèfàn.
B2L14-1-14.english: On New Year's Eve, you must finish worshipping the ancestors before you can eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

B2L14-1-15.chinese: 我喜歡週末跟家人聚在一起吃飯、聊天。愛心服務社把社員的愛心聚在一起，到安養院去幫助老人。
B2L14-1-15.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhōumò gēn jiārén jù zài yìqǐ chīfàn, liáotiān. Àixīn fúwù shè bǎ shèyuán de àixīn jù zài yìqǐ, dào ānyǎng yuàn qù bāngzhù lǎorén.
B2L14-1-15.english: I like to gather with my family on weekends to eat and chat. The Love Service Club gathers the members' love together and goes to the nursing home to help the elderly.

B2L14-1-16.chinese: 我餓的時候，會自己煮飯、煮水餃。
B2L14-1-16.pinyin: Wǒ è de shíhòu, huì zìjǐ zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo.
B2L14-1-16.english: When I am hungry, I cook rice and boil dumplings myself.

B2L14-1-17.chinese: 我餓的時候，會自己煮飯、煮水餃。
B2L14-1-17.pinyin: Wǒ è de shíhòu, huì zìjǐ zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo.
B2L14-1-17.english: When I am hungry, I cook rice and boil dumplings myself.

B2L14-1-18.chinese: 我會煮飯、煮水餃，還會炒米粉呢！
B2L14-1-18.pinyin: Wǒ huì zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo, hái huì chǎo mǐfěn ne!
B2L14-1-18.english: I can cook rice, boil dumplings, and even stir-fry rice noodles!

B2L14-1-19.chinese: 我會煮飯、煮水餃，還會炒米粉呢！
B2L14-1-19.pinyin: Wǒ huì zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo, hái huì chǎo mǐfěn ne!
B2L14-1-19.english: I can cook rice, boil dumplings, and even stir-fry rice noodles!

B2L14-1-20.chinese: 媽媽煎了一條魚，又煮了蘿蔔湯，看起來都很好吃。
B2L14-1-20.pinyin: Māma jiān le yì tiáo yú, yòu zhǔ le luóbo tāng, kànqǐlái dōu hěn hǎochī.
B2L14-1-20.english: Mom pan-fried a fish and also cooked radish soup; they both look delicious.

B2L14-1-22.chinese: 電腦、手機、平板等等，都是3C產品。
B2L14-1-22.pinyin: Diànnǎo, shǒujī, píngbǎn děngděng, dōu shì 3C chǎnpǐn.
B2L14-1-22.english: Computers, cell phones, tablets, and so on are all 3C products.

B2L14-1-23.chinese: 大家都希望發（大）財，這樣就可以買汽車、買房子了。
B2L14-1-23.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xīwàng fā (dà) cái, zhèyàng jiù kěyǐ mǎi qìchē, mǎi fángzi le.
B2L14-1-23.english: Everyone hopes to get rich, so that they can buy cars and houses.

B2L14-1-24.chinese: 媽媽買的橘子酸酸甜甜的，好吃極了！
B2L14-1-24.pinyin: Māma mǎi de júzi suān suāntián tián de, hǎochī jíle!
B2L14-1-24.english: The tangerines that Mom bought are sweet and sour, extremely delicious!

B2L14-1-25.chinese: 我這次考試的成績不太好，下次我會更加努力的。
B2L14-1-25.pinyin: Wǒ zhè cì kǎoshì de chéngjī bú tài hǎo, xià cì wǒ huì gèngjiā nǔlì de.
B2L14-1-25.english: My grades on this exam are not very good; next time I will work even more hard.

B2L14-1-26.chinese: 下課鐘還沒響，可是學生都把背包拿起來準備回家了。
B2L14-1-26.pinyin: Xiàkè zhōng háiméi xiǎng, kěshì xuéshēng dōu bǎ bēibāo ná qǐ lái zhǔnbèi huí jiā le.
B2L14-1-26.english: The class-ending bell has not rung yet, but the students have all picked up their backpacks and are getting ready to go home.

B2L14-1-27.chinese: 陳可欣的舅舅和舅媽都在日本留過學，所以日語說得很好。
B2L14-1-27.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn de jiùjiu hé jiùmā dōu zài Rìběn liú guò xué, suǒyǐ Rì yǔ shuō dehěn hǎo.
B2L14-1-27.english: Chen Kexin's maternal uncle and aunt have both studied in Japan, so they speak Japanese very well.

B2L14-1-29.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生對客人很親切，讓客人吃得很開心。
B2L14-1-29.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng duì kèrén hěn qīnqiè, ràng kèrén chī dehěn kāixīn.
B2L14-1-29.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very kind to customers, so the customers enjoy their meals.

B2L14-1-30.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
B2L14-1-30.pinyin: Àixīn fúwù shè shèyuán qù ānyǎng yuàn péi lǎorén guònián, ràng lǎo rénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
B2L14-1-30.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

B2L14-1-32.chinese: 莫以凡寫了一張卡片，感謝台灣朋友對他的幫助。
B2L14-1-32.pinyin: Mò Yǐfán xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, gǎnxiè Táiwān péngyǒu duì tā de bāngzhù.
B2L14-1-32.english: Mo Yifan wrote a card to thank his Taiwanese friends for their help.

B2L14-2-01.chinese: 從前從前，有一隻很可怕的「動物」，名字叫「年」……
B2L14-2-01.pinyin: Cóngqián cóngqián, yǒu yì zhī hěn kěpà de “dòngwù”, míngzi jiào “nián”…
B2L14-2-01.english: Once upon a time, there was a very scary 'animal' named 'Nian'...

B2L14-2-02.chinese: 「年」是一隻極可怕、會吃人的怪獸，也就是「年獸」。
B2L14-2-02.pinyin: “Nián” shì yì zhī jí kěpà, huì chī rén de guàishòu, yějiùshì “nián shòu”.
B2L14-2-02.english: 'Nian' is an extremely scary man-eating monster, also known as the 'Nian monster'.

B2L14-2-03.chinese: 當寒假一到，大家就準備要過年了。
B2L14-2-03.pinyin: Dāng hánjià yí dào, dàjiā jiù zhǔnbèi yào guònián le.
B2L14-2-03.english: When the winter vacation arrives, everyone gets ready to celebrate the New Year.

B2L14-2-04.chinese: 今年的年夜飯有很多菜，雞鴨魚肉什麼都有。
B2L14-2-04.pinyin: Jīnnián de niányèfàn yǒu hěn duō cài, jī yā yú ròu shénme dōu yǒu.
B2L14-2-04.english: This year's New Year's Eve dinner has many dishes: chicken, duck, fish, meat—everything.

B2L14-2-05.chinese: 因為怕被「年」吃了，所以大家都不能好好地過日子。
B2L14-2-05.pinyin: Yīnwèi pà bèi “nián” chī le, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu bùnéng hǎohǎo de guòrìzi.
B2L14-2-05.english: Because they were afraid of being eaten by 'Nian', everyone could not live their lives peacefully.

B2L14-2-06.chinese: 那位老太太雖然已經八十多歲了，可是身體還很健康。
B2L14-2-06.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai suīrán yǐjīng bāshí duō suì le, kěshì shēntǐ hái hěn jiànkāng.
B2L14-2-06.english: Although that old lady is already over eighty years old, her health is still very good.

B2L14-2-07.chinese: 他很勇敢，十五歲就離開父母，一個人到英國去留學了。
B2L14-2-07.pinyin: Tā hěn yǒnggǎn, shíwǔ suì jiù líkāi fùmǔ, yígerén dào Yīngguó qù liúxué le.
B2L14-2-07.english: He is very brave; at fifteen he left his parents and went to England alone to study abroad.

B2L14-2-08.chinese: 拜拜要用的發糕讓老鼠給吃了，讓媽媽非常生氣。
B2L14-2-08.pinyin: Bàibài yào yòng de fāgāo ràng lǎoshǔ gěi chī le, ràng māma fēicháng shēngqì.
B2L14-2-08.english: The fa gao (prosperity cake) to be used for the worship was eaten by mice, which made Mom very angry.

B2L14-2-09.chinese: 吃什麼我無所謂，不要太辣的就沒問題。
B2L14-2-09.pinyin: Chī shénme wǒ wúsuǒwèi, búyào tài là de jiù méi wèntí.
B2L14-2-09.english: I don't care what we eat, as long as it's not too spicy, there's no problem.

B2L14-2-10.chinese: 六點了，我要洗米煮飯了。
B2L14-2-10.pinyin: Liù diǎn le, wǒ yào xǐ mǐ zhǔ fàn le.
B2L14-2-10.english: It's six o'clock; I need to wash the rice and cook it.

B2L14-2-11.chinese: 我家只有爸爸、媽媽和我三口人。臭豆腐太臭了，有的外國人吃了一口就不吃了。
B2L14-2-11.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zhǐyǒu bàba, māma hé wǒ sān kǒu rén. Chòu dòufǔ tài chòu le, yǒude wàiguó rén chī le yì kǒu jiù bù chī le.
B2L14-2-11.english: There are only three people in my family: Dad, Mom, and me. / Stinky tofu is too stinky; some foreigners take one bite and then don't eat any more.

B2L14-2-12.chinese: 我在森林裡散步的時候，忽然出現了一隻可愛的兔子。
B2L14-2-12.pinyin: Wǒ zài sēnlín lǐ sànbù de shíhòu, hūrán chūxiàn le yì zhī kě'ài de tùzi.
B2L14-2-12.english: While I was taking a walk in the forest, a cute rabbit suddenly appeared.

B2L14-2-13.chinese: 我很餓，同事把他的薯條分一半給我，讓我好感動。
B2L14-2-13.pinyin: Wǒ hěn è, tóngshì bǎ tā de shǔtiáo fēn yíbàn gěi wǒ, ràng wǒ hǎo gǎndòng.
B2L14-2-13.english: I was very hungry, and my colleague shared half of his fries with me, which really moved me.

B2L14-2-14.chinese: 那個老人真可憐，他已經三天沒吃飯了。
B2L14-2-14.pinyin: Nàge lǎorén zhēn kělián, tā yǐjīng sān tiān méi chīfàn le.
B2L14-2-14.english: That old man is really pitiful; he hasn't eaten for three days.

B2L14-2-15.chinese: 台北101大樓的樣子看起來就像竹子一樣節節高升。
B2L14-2-15.pinyin: Táiběi 101 dàlóu de yàngzi kànqǐlái jiù xiàng zhúzi yíyàng jiéjié gāoshēng.
B2L14-2-15.english: The appearance of the Taipei 101 building looks just like bamboo, rising higher section by section.

B2L14-2-16.chinese: 這班捷運一共有十節車廂（chēxiāng, railway carriage）。我們的中文課一節是五十分鐘。
B2L14-2-16.pinyin: Zhè bān jiéyùn yígòng yǒu shí jié chēxiāng (chēxiāng, railway carriage). Wǒmen de Zhōngwén kè yì jié shì wǔshí fēnzhōng.
B2L14-2-16.english: This MRT train has ten cars in all. Each of our Chinese classes is fifty minutes.

B2L14-2-17.chinese: 別在房子裡燒東西，要不然可能會把房子也燒了。
B2L14-2-17.pinyin: Bié zài fángzi lǐ shāo dōngxi, yàobùrán kěnéng huì bǎ fángzi yě shāo le.
B2L14-2-17.english: Don't burn things inside the house, otherwise you might burn the house down too.

B2L14-2-18.chinese: 他們剛剛在燒竹子的時候，火非常大。
B2L14-2-18.pinyin: Tāmen gānggāng zài shāo zhúzi de shíhòu, huǒ fēicháng dà.
B2L14-2-18.english: When they were just burning bamboo, the fire was very big.

B2L14-2-19.chinese: 我聽見樓下有奇怪的聲音，是不是有小偷啊？
B2L14-2-19.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn lóuxià yǒu qíguài de shēngyīn, shìbúshì yǒu xiǎotōu a?
B2L14-2-19.english: I hear a strange sound downstairs—is there a thief?

B2L14-2-20.chinese: 那個小孩一看到大狗，就嚇得哭起來了。
B2L14-2-20.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái yí kàndào dà gǒu, jiù xià de kū qǐlái le.
B2L14-2-20.english: As soon as that child saw the big dog, he was so scared that he started crying.

B2L14-2-21.chinese: 台灣的夏天，差不多五點鐘天就亮了。
B2L14-2-21.pinyin: Táiwān de xiàtiān, chàbùduō wǔ diǎnzhōng tiān jiù liàng le.
B2L14-2-21.english: In summer in Taiwan, the sky is bright at about five o'clock.

B2L14-2-22.chinese: 要不是下大雨，我們就去動物園玩了。
B2L14-2-22.pinyin: Yàobúshì xià dàyǔ, wǒmen jiù qù dòngwùyuán wán le.
B2L14-2-22.english: If it were not for the heavy rain, we would have gone to the zoo to have fun.

B2L14-2-23.chinese: 鞭炮的聲音很可怕，把孩子嚇得哭起來了。等半夜十二點的鐘聲一響，我們就要放鞭炮慶祝新年了。
B2L14-2-23.pinyin: Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiùyào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
B2L14-2-23.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

B2L14-2-24.chinese: 鞭炮的聲音很可怕，把孩子嚇得哭起來了。等半夜十二點的鐘聲一響，我們就要放鞭炮慶祝新年了。
B2L14-2-24.pinyin: Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiùyào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
B2L14-2-24.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

B2L15-1-01.chinese: 那個孩子可真勇敢！連看到蛇也不害怕。
B2L15-1-01.pinyin: Nàge háizi kě zhēn yǒnggǎn! Lián kàndào shé yě bú hàipà.
B2L15-1-01.english: That child is certainly brave! He is not even afraid when he sees a snake.

B2L15-1-02.chinese: 我在車站遇到以前的同事，他現在是一家保險公司的經理。
B2L15-1-02.pinyin: Wǒ zài chēzhàn yùdào yǐqián de tóngshì, tā xiànzài shì yì jiā bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
B2L15-1-02.english: I ran into a former colleague at the station; he is now a manager at an insurance company.

B2L15-1-03.chinese: 去日本，坐飛機比坐船方便得多。
B2L15-1-03.pinyin: Qù Rìběn, zuò fēijī bǐ zuò chuán fāngbiàn de duō.
B2L15-1-03.english: To go to Japan, taking a plane is much more convenient than taking a boat.

B2L15-1-04.chinese: 那座紅色的橋很長、很美。
B2L15-1-04.pinyin: Nà zuò hóngsè de qiáo hěn cháng, hěn měi.
B2L15-1-04.english: That red bridge is very long and very beautiful.

B2L15-1-05.chinese: 王先生跟女朋友吵了一架，現在兩個人不說話了。
B2L15-1-05.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng gēn nǚpéngyǒu chǎo le yí jià, xiànzài liǎng gèrén bù shuōhuà le.
B2L15-1-05.english: Mr. Wang had an argument with his girlfriend; now the two of them are not speaking to each other.

B2L15-1-06.chinese: 那兩個小孩你打我、我推你，不知道在吵什麼？
B2L15-1-06.pinyin: Nà liǎng ge xiǎohái nǐ dǎ wǒ, wǒ tuī nǐ, bù zhīdào zài chǎo shénme?
B2L15-1-06.english: Those two children—you hit me, I push you—I don't know what they are arguing about.

B2L15-1-07.chinese: 那兩個小孩你打我、我推你，不知道在吵什麼？
B2L15-1-07.pinyin: Nà liǎng ge xiǎohái nǐ dǎ wǒ, wǒ tuī nǐ, bù zhīdào zài chǎo shénme?
B2L15-1-07.english: Those two children—you hit me, I push you—I don't know what they are arguing about.

B2L15-1-08.chinese: 妹妹知道自己考上了最好的研究所，激動地哭了起來。
B2L15-1-08.pinyin: Mèimei zhīdào zìjǐ kǎo shàng le zuìhǎo de yánjiùsuǒ, jīdòng de kū le qǐlái.
B2L15-1-08.english: When my younger sister learned that she had gotten into the best graduate school, she was so excited that she started crying.

B2L15-1-09.chinese: 小朋友！別吵架、別打架了，有話好好地說。
B2L15-1-09.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyǒu! Bié chǎojià, bié dǎjià le, yǒu huà hǎohǎo de shuō.
B2L15-1-09.english: Kids! Stop arguing and stop fighting; if you have something to say, say it nicely.

B2L15-1-10.chinese: 小朋友！別吵架、別打架了，有話好好地說。
B2L15-1-10.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyǒu! Bié chǎojià, bié dǎjià le, yǒu huà hǎohǎo de shuō.
B2L15-1-10.english: Kids! Stop arguing and stop fighting; if you have something to say, say it nicely.

B2L15-1-11.chinese: 別指著別人的鼻子說話，這樣很不客氣。
B2L15-1-11.pinyin: Bié zhǐ zhe biérén de bízi shuōhuà, zhèyàng hěn bú kèqì.
B2L15-1-11.english: Don't point at other people's noses when you speak; it is very impolite.

B2L15-1-12.chinese: 搭公車時，年輕人應該讓位子給老人坐，這是一種禮貌。
B2L15-1-12.pinyin: Dā gōngchē shí, niánqīngrén yīnggāi ràng wèizi gěi lǎorén zuò, zhè shì yì zhǒng lǐmào.
B2L15-1-12.english: When riding the bus, young people should give up their seats to the elderly. This is a kind of politeness.

B2L15-1-13.chinese: 那個學生很有禮貌，一看見老師就說：「老師好！」
B2L15-1-13.pinyin: Nàge xuéshēng hěn yǒu lǐmào, yí kànjiàn lǎoshī jiù shuō: “Lǎoshī hǎo!”
B2L15-1-13.english: That student is very polite; as soon as he sees the teacher, he says, "Hello, teacher!"

B2L15-1-14.chinese: 太陽每天都是從東方出來，從西方下去的。莫以凡學了中文以後，他覺得東方文化和西方文化很不一樣。
B2L15-1-14.pinyin: Tàiyáng měitiān dōu shì cóng dōngfāng chūlái, cóng Xīfāng xiàqù de. Mò Yǐfán xué le Zhōngwén yǐhòu, tā juéde dōngfāng wénhuà hé Xīfāng wénhuà hěn bù yíyàng.
B2L15-1-14.english: The sun rises from the east and sets in the west every day. After Yifan Mo studied Chinese, he felt that Eastern culture and Western culture are very different.

B2L15-1-15.chinese: 太陽每天都是從東方出來，從西方下去的。莫以凡學了中文以後，他覺得東方文化和西方文化很不一樣。
B2L15-1-15.pinyin: Tàiyáng měitiān dōu shì cóng dōngfāng chūlái, cóng Xīfāng xiàqù de. Mò Yǐfán xué le Zhōngwén yǐhòu, tā juéde dōngfāng wénhuà hé Xīfāng wénhuà hěn bù yíyàng.
B2L15-1-15.english: The sun rises from the east and sets in the west every day. After Yifan Mo studied Chinese, he felt that Eastern culture and Western culture are very different.

B2L15-1-16.chinese: 在中國，大多數南方人吃飯，北方人吃麵和水餃。
B2L15-1-16.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, dàduōshù nánfāng rén chī fàn, běifāng rén chī miàn hé shuǐjiǎo.
B2L15-1-16.english: In China, most southerners eat rice, while northerners eat noodles and dumplings.

B2L15-1-17.chinese: 在中國，大多數南方人吃飯，北方人吃麵和水餃。
B2L15-1-17.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, dàduōshù nánfāng rén chī fàn, běifāng rén chī miàn hé shuǐjiǎo.
B2L15-1-17.english: In China, most southerners eat rice, while northerners eat noodles and dumplings.

B2L15-1-18.chinese: 去年台灣冬天的溫度很低，只有五度，冷死了。
B2L15-1-18.pinyin: Qùnián Táiwān dōngtiān de wēndù hěn dī, zhǐyǒu wǔ dù, lěng sǐ le.
B2L15-1-18.english: Last year, the temperature in Taiwan in winter was very low—only five degrees—it was freezing!

B2L15-1-19.chinese: 去年台灣冬天的溫度很低，只有五度，冷死了。
B2L15-1-19.pinyin: Qùnián Táiwān dōngtiān de wēndù hěn dī, zhǐyǒu wǔ dù, lěng sǐ le.
B2L15-1-19.english: Last winter the temperature in Taiwan was very low, only five degrees. It was freezing!

B2L15-1-20.chinese: 昨天晚上我發燒到三十九度，那種感覺非常不舒服。
B2L15-1-20.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng wǒ fāshāo dào sānshíjiǔ dù, nàzhǒng gǎnjué fēicháng bù shūfu.
B2L15-1-20.english: Last night my fever went up to thirty-nine degrees, and that feeling was extremely unpleasant.

B2L15-1-21.chinese: 我喜歡夏天到鄉下去住幾天，那裡比都市涼快多了。
B2L15-1-21.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān xiàtiān dào xiāngxià qù zhù jǐ tiān, nàlǐ bǐ dūshì liángkuài duō le.
B2L15-1-21.english: I like to go to the countryside to stay for a few days in summer; it is much more pleasantly cool there than in the city.

B2L15-1-22.chinese: 老師的回答很清楚，所以學生都懂了。
B2L15-1-22.pinyin: Lǎoshī de huídá hěn qīngchǔ, suǒyǐ xuéshēng dōu dǒng le.
B2L15-1-22.english: The teacher's answer was very clear, so all the students understood.

B2L15-1-23.chinese: 沒有人會永遠活著，所以我們每天都要開開心心地生活。
B2L15-1-23.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén huì yǒngyuǎn huózhe, suǒyǐ wǒmen měi tiān dōu yào kāi kāixīn xīn de shēnghuó.
B2L15-1-23.english: No one can live forever, so we should live happily every day.

B2L15-1-24.chinese: 我不懂這句話的意思，可不可以請你給我一個例子？
B2L15-1-24.pinyin: Wǒ bù dǒng zhè jù huà de yìsi, kě bù kěyǐ qǐng nǐ gěi wǒ yíge lìzi?
B2L15-1-24.english: I don't understand the meaning of this sentence; could you please give me an example?

B2L15-1-25.chinese: 用不同的方法教育不同的學生，這樣才是成功的教育方式。
B2L15-1-25.pinyin: Yòng bùtóng de fāngfǎ jiàoyù bùtóng de xuéshēng, zhèyàng cái shì chénggōng de jiàoyù fāngshì.
B2L15-1-25.english: Educating different students with different methods—this is the successful way of education.

B2L15-1-26.chinese: 畢業後能順利找到好工作，是很多大學生的希望。
B2L15-1-26.pinyin: Bìyè hòu néng shùnlì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò, shì hěn duō dàxuéshēng de xīwàng.
B2L15-1-26.english: Being able to smoothly find a good job after graduation is the hope of many university students.

B2L15-2-01.chinese: 今天你必須把報告交給教授，要不然一定會被當。
B2L15-2-01.pinyin: Jīntiān nǐ bìxū bǎ bàogào jiāogěi jiàoshòu, yàobùrán yídìng huì bèi dāng.
B2L15-2-01.english: You must hand your report in to the professor today, or you will definitely fail.

B2L15-2-02.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
B2L15-2-02.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
B2L15-2-02.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

B2L15-2-04.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
B2L15-2-04.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
B2L15-2-04.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

B2L15-2-05.chinese: 「教師節」這個節日是為了紀念偉大的孔子。
B2L15-2-05.pinyin: “Jiàoshījié” zhège jiérì shì wèile jìniàn wěidà de Kǒngzǐ.
B2L15-2-05.english: The holiday "Teachers' Day" is for commemorating the great Confucius.

B2L15-2-06.chinese: 他年輕時曾經去過很多國家旅遊，現在老了，沒體力出國了。
B2L15-2-06.pinyin: Tā niánqīng shí céngjīng qù guo hěn duō guójiā lǚyóu, xiànzài lǎo le, méi tǐlì chūguó le.
B2L15-2-06.english: When he was young, he once traveled to many countries; now he is old and doesn't have the energy to go abroad.

B2L15-2-07.chinese: 我不曾一個人去旅行，總是參加團體旅遊。
B2L15-2-07.pinyin: Wǒ bù céng yígerén qù lǚxíng, zǒngshì cānjiā tuántǐ lǚyóu.
B2L15-2-07.english: I have never traveled alone; I always join group tours.

B2L15-2-08.chinese: 下個星期我要和經理一起到美國去出差。
B2L15-2-08.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí wǒ yào hé jīnglǐ yìqǐ dào Měiguó qù chūchāi.
B2L15-2-08.english: Next week I will go to the US on a business trip together with the manager.

B2L15-2-09.chinese: 我不懂政治，對政治也沒有興趣。
B2L15-2-09.pinyin: Wǒ bù dǒng zhèngzhì, duì zhèngzhì yě méiyǒu xìngqù.
B2L15-2-09.english: I don't understand politics, and I'm not interested in politics either.

B2L15-2-10.chinese: 我的理想是找到一份正式的工作，過幸福的生活。
B2L15-2-10.pinyin: Wǒ de lǐxiǎng shì zhǎodào yí fèn zhèngshì de gōngzuò, guò xìngfú de shēnghuó.
B2L15-2-10.english: My ideal is to find a formal job and live a happy life.

B2L15-2-11.chinese: 為了給孩子幸福的生活，很多父母一輩子都努力地工作。王先生這輩子沒結婚，他希望下輩子會有機會。
B2L15-2-11.pinyin: Wèile gěi háizi xìngfú de shēnghuó, hěn duō fùmǔ yí bèizi dōu nǔlì de gōngzuò. Wáng xiānshēng zhè bèizi méi jiéhūn, tā xīwàng xià bèizi huì yǒu jīhuì.
B2L15-2-11.english: In order to give their children a happy life, many parents work hard their whole life. Mr. Wang hasn't married in this lifetime; he hopes he will have a chance in the next life.

B2L15-2-12.chinese: 孔子希望君王能夠接受他的建議來管理國家。
B2L15-2-12.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ xīwàng jūnwáng nénggòu jiēshòu tā de jiànyì lái guǎnlǐ guójiā.
B2L15-2-12.english: Confucius hoped that the king could accept his advice to govern the country.

B2L15-2-13.chinese: 孔子希望君王能夠接受他的建議來管理國家。
B2L15-2-13.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ xīwàng jūnwáng nénggòu jiēshòu tā de jiànyì lái guǎnlǐ guójiā.
B2L15-2-13.english: Confucius hoped that the king could accept his advice to govern the country.

B2L15-2-14.chinese: 陳先生在醫院裡著急地等待小孩出生。有些人等待了一輩子，都等不到高升的機會。
B2L15-2-14.pinyin: Chén xiānshēng zài yīyuàn lǐ zhāojí de děngdài xiǎohái chūshēng. Yǒuxiē rén děngdài le yíbèizi, dōu děng búdào gāoshēng de jīhuì.
B2L15-2-14.english: Mr. Chen is anxiously waiting in the hospital for his child to be born. Some people wait their whole life and never get a chance for promotion.

B2L15-2-15.chinese: 任何人跟他說話，他都不聽，怎麼這麼奇怪？
B2L15-2-15.pinyin: Rènhé rén gēn tā shuōhuà, tā dōu bù tīng, zěnme zhème qíguài?
B2L15-2-15.english: No matter who talks to him, he doesn't listen—how can he be so strange?

B2L15-2-16.chinese: A:聽說王先生有很多女朋友。 B:真的嗎？我不信他是這種人。
B2L15-2-16.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Wáng xiānshēng yǒu hěn duō nǚpéngyǒu. B: Zhēnde ma? Wǒ bú xìn tā shì zhè zhǒng rén.
B2L15-2-16.english: A: I heard Mr. Wang has many girlfriends. B: Really? I don't believe he's that kind of person.

B2L15-2-17.chinese: 店員把筆電的功能說明得很清楚，所以客人都明白了。
B2L15-2-17.pinyin: Diànyuán bǎ bǐdiàn de gōngnéng shuōmíng dehěn qīngchǔ, suǒyǐ kèrén dōu míngbái le.
B2L15-2-17.english: The clerk explained the functions of the laptop very clearly, so the customers all understood.

B2L15-2-18.chinese: 我想去看電影，可是明天有考試，不得不在家準備。
B2L15-2-18.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng, kěshì míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, bùdébù zàijiā zhǔnbèi.
B2L15-2-18.english: I want to go see a movie, but I have an exam tomorrow, so I have no choice but to prepare at home.

B2L15-2-19.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
B2L15-2-19.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
B2L15-2-19.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

B2L15-2-20.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
B2L15-2-20.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
B2L15-2-20.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

B2L15-2-21.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
B2L15-2-21.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
B2L15-2-21.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

B2L15-2-22.chinese: 我們的成長經驗、教育背景都差不多，所以想法也很像。
B2L15-2-22.pinyin: Wǒmen de chéngzhǎng jīngyàn, jiàoyù bèijǐng dōu chàbùduō, suǒyǐ xiǎngfǎ yě hěn xiàng.
B2L15-2-22.english: Our upbringing experiences and educational backgrounds are about the same, so our ideas are also very similar.

B2L15-2-23.chinese: 這個孩子非常聰明，一點兒都不笨。
B2L15-2-23.pinyin: Zhège háizi fēicháng cōngmíng, yìdiǎnr dōu bú bèn.
B2L15-2-23.english: This child is very smart and not stupid at all.

B2L15-2-24.chinese: 老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現，明年要讓他當經理呢！這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。
B2L15-2-24.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
B2L15-2-24.english: The boss is very pleased with Xiao Chen's work performance and will make him manager next year! This competition is very important, so everyone must perform well.

B2L15-2-25.chinese: 因為每天跟台灣人練習說話，莫以凡的中文程度越來越好了。
B2L15-2-25.pinyin: Yīnwèi měitiān gēn Táiwān rén liànxí shuōhuà, Mò Yǐfán de Zhōngwén chéngdù yuèláiyuè hǎo le.
B2L15-2-25.english: Because he practices speaking with Taiwanese people every day, Mo Yifan's Chinese level is getting better and better.

B2L15-2-26.chinese: 父母應該好好地教育孩子，讓他們明白做人、做事的道理。
B2L15-2-26.pinyin: Fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo de jiàoyù háizi, ràng tāmen míngbái zuòrén, zuòshì de dàolǐ.
B2L15-2-26.english: Parents should educate their children well, so that they understand the principles of conducting oneself and doing things.

B2L15-2-27.chinese: 筆電的價格和功能，都會影響顧客的選擇。
B2L15-2-27.pinyin: Bǐdiàn de jiàgé hé gōngnéng, dōu huì yǐngxiǎng gùkè de xuǎnzé.
B2L15-2-27.english: The price and functions of laptops both influence customers' choices.

B2L16-1-01.chinese: 高雄是台灣南部最大的城市，舉辦過世界運動會。
B2L16-1-01.pinyin: Gāoxióng shì Táiwān nánbù zuì dà de chéngshì, jǔbàn guò Shìjiè Yùndònghuì.
B2L16-1-01.english: Kaohsiung is the largest city in southern Taiwan and has held the World Games.

B2L16-1-02.chinese: 上課的時候，如果你有問題就舉手問老師。
B2L16-1-02.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhòu, rúguǒ nǐ yǒu wèntí jiù jǔshǒu wèn lǎoshī.
B2L16-1-02.english: During class, if you have a question, just raise your hand and ask the teacher.

B2L16-1-03.chinese: 這本書的內容很有意思，介紹了很多義大利的飲食文化。
B2L16-1-03.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng hěn yǒuyìsi, jièshào le hěn duō Yìdàlì de yǐnshí wénhuà.
B2L16-1-03.english: The content of this book is very interesting; it introduces a lot of Italian food culture.

B2L16-1-04.chinese: 吃太鹹或太甜的東西，對身體都不好。
B2L16-1-04.pinyin: Chī tài xián huò tài tián de dōngxi, duì shēntǐ dōu bùhǎo.
B2L16-1-04.english: Eating things that are too salty or too sweet is not good for your health.

B2L16-1-05.chinese: 世界文化日那天，你想表演什麼？
B2L16-1-05.pinyin: Shìjiè Wénhuàrì nà tiān, nǐ xiǎng biǎoyǎn shénme?
B2L16-1-05.english: On World Culture Day, what do you want to perform?

B2L16-1-06.chinese: 中華民族有五、六千年的歷史了。
B2L16-1-06.pinyin: Zhōnghuá mínzú yǒu wǔ, liùqiān nián de lìshǐ le.
B2L16-1-06.english: The Chinese nation has a history of five or six thousand years.

B2L16-1-07.chinese: 我爺爺的想法很傳統，除夕一定要大家回去吃年夜飯。
B2L16-1-07.pinyin: Wǒ yéye de xiǎngfǎ hěn chuántǒng, Chúxī yídìng yào dàjiā huíqù chī niányèfàn.
B2L16-1-07.english: My grandfather's thinking is very traditional; on New Year's Eve, he insists that everyone go back to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

B2L16-1-09.chinese: 那位教授看報告看得很仔細，你可不能亂寫。
B2L16-1-09.pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu kàn bàogào kàn dehěn zǐxì, nǐ kě bùnéng luàn xiě.
B2L16-1-09.english: That professor reads reports very carefully; you must not write carelessly.

B2L16-1-10.chinese: 這個麵包的名字叫「髒髒包」，聽起來怪怪的，可是吃起來很好吃。
B2L16-1-10.pinyin: Zhège miànbāo de míngzi jiào “zāngzāng bāo”, tīngqǐlái guài guài de, kěshì chī qǐlái hěn hǎochī.
B2L16-1-10.english: This bread is called "dirty bread"; it sounds strange, but it tastes delicious.

B2L16-1-11.chinese: 我嚐了一口納豆就不敢吃了。
B2L16-1-11.pinyin: Wǒ cháng le yìkǒu Nàdòu jiù bù gǎn chī le.
B2L16-1-11.english: I took one taste of natto and didn't dare eat it anymore.

B2L16-1-12.chinese: 到底哪一種冰淇淋最好吃，得看個人的口味。
B2L16-1-12.pinyin: Dàodǐ nǎ yì zhǒng bīngqílín zuìhǎo chī, děi kàn gèrén de kǒuwèi.
B2L16-1-12.english: Which kind of ice cream is the most delicious ultimately depends on individual taste.

B2L16-1-13.chinese: 到底哪一種冰淇淋最好吃，得看個人的口味。
B2L16-1-13.pinyin: Dàodǐ nǎ yì zhǒng bīngqílín zuìhǎo chī, děi kàn gèrén de kǒuwèi.
B2L16-1-13.english: Which kind of ice cream is the most delicious ultimately depends on individual taste.

B2L16-1-14.chinese: 夏天的晚上，我喜歡去公園散散步、吹吹風。
B2L16-1-14.pinyin: Xiàtiān de wǎnshàng, wǒ xǐhuān qù gōngyuán sàn sànbù, chuī chuī fēng.
B2L16-1-14.english: On summer evenings, I like to go to the park for a walk and to enjoy the breeze.

B2L16-1-15.chinese: 他吹笛子吹得很好，辦過幾場很成功的音樂表演。
B2L16-1-15.pinyin: Tā chuī dízi chuī dehěn hǎo, bàn guò jǐ chǎng hěn chénggōng de yīnyuè biǎoyǎn.
B2L16-1-15.english: He plays the flute very well and has held several very successful music performances.

B2L16-1-16.chinese: 台灣有各式各樣的小吃，其中最吸引我的是蚵仔煎。
B2L16-1-16.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, qízhōng zuì xīyǐn wǒ de shì ézǐjiān.
B2L16-1-16.english: Taiwan has all kinds of snacks, among which the one that attracts me most is oyster omelet.

B2L16-1-17.chinese: 每個民族都有自己的風俗習慣，有時候外國人不容易了解。
B2L16-1-17.pinyin: Měige mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de fēngsú xíguàn, yǒushíhòu wàiguórén bù róngyì liǎojiě.
B2L16-1-17.english: Every ethnic group has its own customs, which foreigners sometimes find hard to understand.

B2L16-1-20.chinese: 華語文中心的學生都很會跳舞，其中跳得最好的是非洲學生。
B2L16-1-20.pinyin: Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn de xuéshēng dōu hěn huì tiàowǔ, qízhōng tiào de zuìhǎo de shì Fēizhōu xuéshēng.
B2L16-1-20.english: The students at the Mandarin Learning Center are all very good at dancing; among them, the one who dances the best is the African student.

B2L16-1-23.chinese: 出國留學有很多好處，除了學習語言，還有文化交流的機會。
B2L16-1-23.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu hěn duō hǎochù, chúle xuéxí yǔyán, háiyǒu wénhuà jiāoliú de jīhuì.
B2L16-1-23.english: Studying abroad has many benefits; besides learning a language, there are also opportunities for cultural exchange.

B2L16-1-24.chinese: 我有一個幸福的家庭，父母都很愛我。
B2L16-1-24.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yíge xìngfú de jiātíng, fùmǔ dōu hěn ài wǒ.
B2L16-1-24.english: I have a happy family, and my parents both love me very much.

B2L16-1-25.chinese: 我等了半天公車還是沒來，只好坐計程車去上班。
B2L16-1-25.pinyin: Wǒ děng le bàntiān gōngchē háishì méi lái, zhǐhǎo zuò jìchéngchē qù shàngbān.
B2L16-1-25.english: I waited for the bus for a long time and it still didn't come, so I had no choice but to take a taxi to work.

B2L16-1-27.chinese: 這家大飯店的禮堂很漂亮，很多人都在這裡結婚、請客。
B2L16-1-27.pinyin: Zhè jiā dà fàndiàn de lǐtáng hěn piàoliàng, hěn duō rén dōu zài zhèlǐ jiéhūn, qǐngkè.
B2L16-1-27.english: The hall of this grand hotel is very beautiful; many people get married and hold banquets here.

B2L16-1-29.chinese: 今年新年晚會的會場，在學校的大禮堂。
B2L16-1-29.pinyin: Jīnnián xīnnián wǎnhuì de huìchǎng, zài xuéxiào de dà lǐtáng.
B2L16-1-29.english: The venue for this year's New Year party is in the school's grand auditorium.

B2L16-1-30.chinese: 在德國舉辦的歐洲足球比賽，一共有十二個國家報名。
B2L16-1-30.pinyin: Zài Déguó jǔbàn de Ōuzhōu zúqiú bǐsài, yígòng yǒu shí'èr ge guójiā bàomíng.
B2L16-1-30.english: For the European football match held in Germany, a total of twelve countries registered.

B2L16-2-01.chinese: 華語文中心的外國學生，邀請台灣朋友來參加世界文化日的活動。
B2L16-2-01.pinyin: Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn de wàiguó xuéshēng, yāoqǐng Táiwān péngyǒu lái cānjiā Shìjiè Wénhuàrì de huódòng.
B2L16-2-01.english: The international students of the Chinese Language Center invite their Taiwanese friends to join the World Culture Day activities.

B2L16-2-02.chinese: 外國學生照學校的安排，每週上六堂中文課。
B2L16-2-02.pinyin: Wàiguó xuéshēng zhào xuéxiào de ānpái, měizhōu shàng liù táng Zhōngwén kè.
B2L16-2-02.english: Following the school's arrangement, the international students have six Chinese classes a week.

B2L16-2-03.chinese: 日本在台灣的東北方；台灣在中國的東南方。
B2L16-2-03.pinyin: Rìběn zài Táiwān de dōngběi fāng; Táiwān zài Zhōngguó de dōng nánfāng.
B2L16-2-03.english: Japan is to the northeast of Taiwan; Taiwan is to the southeast of China.

B2L16-2-05.chinese: 日本在台灣的東北方；台灣在中國的東南方。
B2L16-2-05.pinyin: Rìběn zài Táiwān de dōngběi fāng; Táiwān zài Zhōngguó de dōngnán fāng.
B2L16-2-05.english: Japan is to the northeast of Taiwan; Taiwan is to the southeast of China.

B2L16-2-08.chinese: 這個影片介紹了亞洲的飲食文化。
B2L16-2-08.pinyin: Zhège yǐngpiàn jièshào le Yàzhōu de yǐnshí wénhuà.
B2L16-2-08.english: This video introduced Asia's food culture.

B2L16-2-09.chinese: 許多大學生參加愛心服務的社團，幫助老人打掃環境。
B2L16-2-09.pinyin: Xǔduō dàxuéshēng cānjiā àixīn fúwù de shètuán, bāngzhù lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng.
B2L16-2-09.english: Many university students join volunteer service clubs to help the elderly clean up the environment.

B2L16-2-10.chinese: 聽說校長要親自帶學生去醫院照顧病人。
B2L16-2-10.pinyin: Tīngshuō xiàozhǎng yào qīnzì dài xuéshēng qù yīyuàn zhàogù bìngrén.
B2L16-2-10.english: I heard that the principal is going to personally lead students to the hospital to care for patients.

B2L16-2-11.chinese: 校長要親自帶學生去參加電腦遊戲比賽，希望能得到好成績。
B2L16-2-11.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng yào qīnzì dài xuéshēng qù cānjiā diànnǎo yóuxì bǐsài, xīwàng néng dédào hǎo chéngjī.
B2L16-2-11.english: The principal will personally take the students to a computer game competition, hoping they will get good results.

B2L16-2-12.chinese: 那家玩具工廠的員工當中，陳先生的工作表現最好。
B2L16-2-12.pinyin: Nà jiā wánjù gōngchǎng de yuángōng dāngzhōng, Chén xiānshēng de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn zuìhǎo.
B2L16-2-12.english: Among the employees of that toy factory, Mr. Chen's work performance is the best.

B2L16-2-13.chinese: 越南同學的表演太棒了，我們一直拍手叫好！
B2L16-2-13.pinyin: Yuènán tóngxué de biǎoyǎn tài bàng le, wǒmen yìzhí pāishǒujiàohǎo!
B2L16-2-13.english: The Vietnamese classmate's performance was so great that we kept clapping and cheering!

B2L16-2-15.chinese: 張教授上課的方式很活潑，所以很多學生要選他的課。
B2L16-2-15.pinyin: Zhāng jiàoshòu shàngkè de fāngshì hěn huópō, suǒyǐ hěn duō xuéshēng yào xuǎn tā de kè.
B2L16-2-15.english: Professor Zhang's teaching style is very lively, so many students want to take his class.

B2L16-2-16.chinese: 金小姐從來不請客，沒想到今天很大方，請所有的同事吃披薩呢！張先生的個性活潑大方，難怪有很多朋友。
B2L16-2-16.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě cóngláibù qǐngkè, méixiǎngdào jīntiān hěn dàfāng, qǐng suǒyǒu de tóngshì chī pīsà ne! Zhāng xiānshēng de gèxìng huópō dàfāng, nánguài yǒu hěn duō péngyǒu.
B2L16-2-16.english: Miss Jin never treats anyone, so it is surprising that today she was generous and treated all her colleagues to pizza! Mr. Zhang has a lively, natural and poised personality, no wonder he has many friends.

B2L16-2-17.chinese: 我哥哥很喜歡說笑話，跟他在一起很開心。
B2L16-2-17.pinyin: Wǒ gēge hěn xǐhuān shuō xiàohuà, gēn tā zài yìqǐ hěn kāixīn.
B2L16-2-17.english: My older brother really likes to tell jokes; being with him is very fun.

B2L16-2-18.chinese: 那個店員經常對客人微笑，讓人覺得很親切。
B2L16-2-18.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán jīngcháng duì kèrén wéixiào, ràng rén juéde hěn qīnqiè.
B2L16-2-18.english: That clerk often smiles at customers, making people feel very friendly.

B2L16-2-19.chinese: 今天南部地區的空氣很差，出門最好戴口罩。
B2L16-2-19.pinyin: Jīntiān nánbù dìqū de kōngqì hěn chà, chūmén zuìhǎo dài kǒuzhào.
B2L16-2-19.english: The air quality in the southern region is poor today, so it is best to wear a mask when going out.

B2L16-2-20.chinese: 在古代的中國，只有有錢、有背景的人才可以去學校讀書。
B2L16-2-20.pinyin: Zài gǔdài de Zhōngguó, zhǐyǒu yǒu qián, yǒu bèijǐng de réncái kěyǐ qù xuéxiào dúshū.
B2L16-2-20.english: In ancient China, only people with money and background could go to school to study.

B2L16-2-21.chinese: 我喜歡觀察小動物走來走去的樣子。
B2L16-2-21.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān guānchá xiǎo dòngwù zǒu lái zǒu qù de yàngzi.
B2L16-2-21.english: I like to observe the way small animals walk back and forth.

B2L16-2-22.chinese: 你老是批評別人，誰想跟你做朋友呢？
B2L16-2-22.pinyin: Nǐ lǎoshì pīpíng biérén, shéi xiǎng gēn nǐ zuò péngyǒu ne?
B2L16-2-22.english: You are always criticizing others; who would want to be friends with you?

B2L03-1-18.chinese: 你的臥室看起來真漂亮！
B2L03-1-18.pinyin: Nǐ de wòshì kànqǐlái zhēn piàoliàng!

B2L03-1-29.chinese: 這個房子的房租不包括水費、電費。
B2L03-1-29.pinyin: Zhège fángzi de fángzū bù bāokuò shuǐfèi, diànfèi.
B2L03-1-29.english: The rent for this house does not include the water and electricity fees.

B2L04-1-09.chinese: 在夜市買東西的時候，有些人會跟老闆殺價。
B2L04-1-09.pinyin: Zài yèshì mǎidōngxi de shíhòu, yǒuxiērén huì gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
B2L04-1-09.english: When shopping at a night market, some people bargain with the vendor.

B2L06-2-03.chinese: 李先生每天晚上六點前一定要吃晚飯，八點後就什麼東西都不吃了。
B2L06-2-03.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng měitiān wǎnshàng liù diǎn qián yídìng yào chī wǎnfàn, bā diǎn hòu jiù shénme dōngxi dōu bù chī le.
B2L06-2-03.english: Mr. Li must eat dinner before six every evening, and after eight he eats nothing at all.

B2L08-1-02.chinese: 請不要把貼紙貼在教室的桌子上。
B2L08-1-02.pinyin: Qǐng búyào bǎ tiēzhǐ tiē zài jiàoshì de zhuōzi shàng.
B2L08-1-02.english: Please don't stick stickers on the desks in the classroom.

B2L10-2-16.chinese: 醫生建議這個病人每天游泳游三十分鐘，這樣體力、精神就會越來越好的。
B2L10-2-16.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì zhège bìngrén měitiān yóuyǒng yóu sān shífēn zhōng, zhèyàng tǐlì, jīngshén jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de.
B2L10-2-16.english: The doctor suggests that this patient swim for thirty minutes every day, so that his strength and energy will get better and better.

B2L12-2-03.chinese: 我家有一個小花園，媽媽有空就在那裡種花、剪草。
B2L12-2-03.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yíge xiǎo huāyuán, māma yǒukòng jiù zài nàlǐ zhǒng huā, jiǎn cǎo.
B2L12-2-03.english: My family has a small garden, where my mother plants flowers and trims the grass whenever she has time.

B2L13-1-23.chinese: 台灣的便利商店可以收傳真，方便極了！
B2L13-1-23.pinyin: Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn kěyǐ shōu chuánzhēn, fāngbiàn jíle!
B2L13-1-23.english: Convenience stores in Taiwan can receive faxes, which is extremely convenient!

B2L13-1-24.chinese: 台灣的便利商店可以收傳真，方便極了！
B2L13-1-24.pinyin: Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn kěyǐ shōu chuánzhēn, fāngbiàn jíle!
B2L13-1-24.english: Convenience stores in Taiwan can receive faxes, which is extremely convenient!

B2L14-1-11.chinese: 去那座寺廟拜拜的人真多，他們在拜什麼？
B2L14-1-11.pinyin: Qù nà zuò sìmiào bàibài de rén zhēn duō, tāmen zài bài shénme?
B2L14-1-11.english: So many people are going to that temple to worship. What are they worshipping?

B2L14-1-21.chinese: 媽媽煎了一條魚，又煮了蘿蔔湯，看起來都很好吃。
B2L14-1-21.pinyin: Māma jiān le yì tiáo yú, yòu zhǔ le luóbo tāng, kànqǐlái dōu hěn hǎochī.
B2L14-1-21.english: Mom pan-fried a fish and also cooked radish soup; it all looks delicious.

B2L14-1-28.chinese: 陳可欣的舅舅和舅媽都在日本留過學，所以日語說得很好。
B2L14-1-28.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn de jiùjiu hé jiùmā dōu zài Rìběn liú guò xué, suǒyǐ rì yǔ shuō dehěn hǎo.
B2L14-1-28.english: Kexin Chen's uncle and aunt both studied in Japan, so they speak Japanese very well.

B2L14-1-31.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
B2L14-1-31.pinyin: Àixīn fúwù shè shèyuán qù ānyǎng yuàn péi lǎorén guònián, ràng lǎo rénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
B2L14-1-31.english: Members of the Caring Service Club went to the nursing home to spend the New Year with the elderly, which made them feel quite warm inside.

B2L16-1-28.chinese: 這家大飯店的禮堂很漂亮，很多人都在這裡結婚、請客。
B2L16-1-28.pinyin: Zhè jiā dà fàndiàn de lǐtáng hěn piàoliàng, hěn duō rén dōu zài zhèlǐ jiéhūn, qǐngkè.
B2L16-1-28.english: The hall of this big hotel is beautiful. Many people hold their weddings and banquets here.

B2L10-1-49.chinese: 那隻老虎生病了，三天沒吃東西也沒喝水，好像快死了。
B2L10-1-49.pinyin: Nà zhī lǎohǔ shēngbìng le, sān tiān méi chī dōngxi yě méi hē shuǐ, hǎoxiàng kuài sǐ le.
B2L10-1-49.english: That tiger is sick. It hasn't eaten or drunk anything for three days and seems about to die.

B2L14-1-41.chinese: 我從來沒去過美術館，因為我對藝術不感興趣。
B2L14-1-41.pinyin: Wǒ cónglái méi qù guò měishùguǎn, yīnwèi wǒ duì yìshù bù gǎnxìngqù.
B2L14-1-41.english: I have never been to an art museum, because I'm not interested in art.

B2L15-2-29.chinese: 這家商店的 3C 產品平常不打折，只有今天打九折。
B2L15-2-29.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn de 3C chǎnpǐn píngcháng bù dǎzhé, zhǐyǒu jīntiān dǎ jiǔzhé.
B2L15-2-29.english: This store's 3C products are normally not discounted; only today they are 10% off.
